name: Crow
description: Crows are the small black birds that perch in trees and circle the air across the Meadows and Black Forest. They are passive and yield Feathers when killed.

name: Leviathan
description: Leviathans are docile entities discovered in Oceans. They are colossal rock-like beings that possess a 25% probability of submerging each time their Abyssal barnacles sustain damage.

name: Odin
description: Odin is a character encountered in Valheim. He appears as an enigmatic figure cloaked in black, characterized by a single, shining blue eye and a walking stick held in his right hand. A soft blue aura surrounds him for as long as he is present.

name: Gull
description: Gulls are passive entities encountered in Valheim. They are compact birds with lengthy legs and robust, straight beaks. These birds mainly exhibit a white hue, equipped with a yellow beak, grey wings, and legs and feet of a pinkish-beige color.

name: Wisp
game_description: It keeps whispering jibberish...
description: A Wisp is a glowing spirit collected from Wisps in the Mistlands using the Wisplight accessory. They are used to craft the Wisp torch and Wisplight, which dispel Mistlands fog.

name: Bronze plate cuirass
game_description: A breastplate of hammered bronze.
description: The Bronze plate cuirass is the chest piece of the Bronze armor set, the first heavy armor unlocked in the Black Forest era. It is crafted at a Forge from Bronze and Deer hide and applies a small movement speed penalty in exchange for solid protection.

name: Bronze plate leggings
game_description: Bronze greaves to shield your legs.
description: Bronze plate leggings are the leg piece of the Bronze armor set, the first heavy armor unlocked in the Black Forest era. They are forged from Bronze and Deer hide and apply a small movement speed penalty in exchange for solid protection.

name: Fenris coat
game_description: The beast could draw deep breaths, so that its howl could be heard far across the land.
description: The Fenris coat is the chest piece of the Fenris set, a Mountain-tier light armor crafted from Fenris hair, Wolf pelts, and a Cultist trophy. Each piece grants +3% movement speed and the full three-piece set provides +15 Fists skill and fire resistance.

name: Fenris leggings
game_description: The legs of the beast were lean and strong, so that it could leap great strides.
description: Fenris leggings are the leg piece of the Fenris set, a Mountain-tier light armor crafted from Fenris hair, Wolf pelts, and a Cultist trophy. Each piece grants +3% movement speed and the full three-piece set provides +15 Fists skill and fire resistance.

name: Iron scale mail
game_description: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.
description: Iron scale mail is the chest piece of the Iron armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Swamp era. It is forged from Iron and Deer hide, offering strong protection at the cost of a small movement speed penalty.

name: Iron greaves
game_description: Iron greaves to protect your legs.
description: Iron greaves are the leg piece of the Iron armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Swamp era. They are forged from Iron and Deer hide and apply a small movement speed penalty in exchange for strong protection.

name: Leather tunic
game_description: A tunic made from animal hide.
description: The Leather tunic is the chest piece of the Leather armor set, an early light armor crafted at a Workbench from Deer hide. It is one of the first armor sets Vikings can build in the Meadows.

name: Leather pants
game_description: They squeak a little when you walk.
description: Leather pants are the leg piece of the Leather armor set, an early light armor crafted at a Workbench from Deer hide. They are one of the first armor pieces Vikings can build in the Meadows.

name: Padded cuirass
game_description: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.
description: The Padded cuirass is the chest piece of the Padded armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Plains era. It offers the strongest non-Mistlands chest protection at the cost of a small movement speed penalty, and is forged from Iron and Linen thread.

name: Padded greaves
game_description: Expertly crafted leg protection.
description: Padded greaves are the leg piece of the Padded armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Plains era. They offer the strongest non-Mistlands leg protection at the cost of a small movement speed penalty, and are forged from Iron and Linen thread.

name: Rag tunic
game_description: Better than nothing.
description: The Rag tunic is the chest piece of the Rag armor set, Valheim's most basic starter armor. It is crafted at a Workbench from a few Leather scraps and is intended only to bridge the gap until a Leather set is ready.

name: Rag pants
game_description: A simple remedy for nudity.
description: Rag pants are the leg piece of the Rag armor set, Valheim's most basic starter armor. They are crafted at a Workbench from a few Leather scraps and are intended only to bridge the gap until a Leather set is ready.

name: Root harnesk
game_description: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.
description: The Root harnesk is the chest piece of the Root armor set, a Swamp-era light armor crafted from Root and Ancient bark. It grants resistance to Pierce damage but is weak to Fire, and the full set gives a +15 Bows skill bonus, making it the go-to choice for archers.

name: Root leggings
game_description: A light armour oddly woven together by ancient roots and bark.
description: Root leggings are the leg piece of the Root armor set, a Swamp-era light armor crafted from Root and Ancient bark. They are weak to Fire, and the full set grants a +15 Bows skill bonus, making it the go-to choice for archers.

name: Troll leather tunic
game_description: Trolls are hard to skin but their leather is tough and warm.
description: The Troll leather tunic is the chest piece of the Troll armor set, a Black Forest-era light armor crafted from Troll hide. The full set grants a +15 Sneak skill bonus, making it ideal for stealth-focused exploration.

name: Troll leather pants
game_description: Leggings of tough troll hide.
description: Troll leather pants are the leg piece of the Troll armor set, a Black Forest-era light armor crafted from Troll hide. The full set grants a +15 Sneak skill bonus, making it ideal for stealth-focused exploration.

name: Wolf armor chest
game_description: A wolfskin jerkin, warm and wild-looking. It protects against the cold.
description: The Wolf armor chest is the chest piece of the Wolf armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Mountain era. It is forged from Silver, Wolf pelts, and a Wolf trophy, and grants natural frost resistance for fighting in cold biomes.

name: Wolf armor legs
game_description: Shaggy breeches of wolfskin.
description: Wolf armor legs are the leg piece of the Wolf armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Mountain era. They are forged from Silver and Wolf pelts and grant natural frost resistance for fighting in cold biomes.

name: Megingjord
game_description: Gives the wearer superhuman strength.
description: Megingjord is a strength belt that grants the wearer +150 carry weight when equipped. It is sold by Haldor the trader for 950 coins and shares its accessory slot with the Wishbone and the Wisplight, so only one can be worn at a time.

name: Deer hide cape
game_description: Rustic chic.
description: The Deer hide cape is an early-game cape crafted at a Workbench from Deer hide and Bone fragments. It provides basic cold protection for venturing into the edges of the Black Forest at night.

name: Linen cape
game_description: A simple traveler's cape.
description: The Linen cape is a late-game cape crafted from Linen thread and Silver. It is purely cosmetic among the standard capes, lacking any elemental resistance, but pairs well with the Padded armor set as part of an end-game look.

name: Lox cape
game_description: A pelt from one of the great beasts, thick and warm.
description: The Lox cape is a Plains-era cape crafted from Lox pelt and Silver. It grants frost resistance, replacing the need for Frost resistance mead when traversing the Mountains.

name: Cape of Odin
game_description: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest cloth.
description: The Cape of Odin is a cosmetic cape included with the Valheim DLC. It is crafted from Leather scraps and Coal and offers no combat bonuses, serving only as a visual flourish for Odin's finest warriors.

name: CAPE TEST
game_description: Da cape
description: CAPE TEST is an internal developer test item that is not intended for normal gameplay. It can only be spawned with the console and has no production purpose.

name: Troll hide cape
game_description: Trollskin is tough and supple.
description: The Troll hide cape is a Black Forest-era cape crafted from Troll hide and Bone fragments. Worn alongside the Troll armor set, it contributes to the +15 Sneak set bonus for stealth-focused builds.

name: Wolf fur cape
game_description: Wolves are natural survivors. This one was just unlucky. Now its pelt will warm you in the snow.
description: The Wolf fur cape is a Mountain-era cape crafted from Wolf pelts and Silver. It grants frost resistance, removing the need for Frost resistance mead when traversing the Mountains.

name: Bronze helmet
game_description: This will help to keep your brains inside your skull.
description: The Bronze helmet is the head piece of the Bronze armor set, the first heavy armor unlocked in the Black Forest era. It is forged from Bronze and Deer hide.

name: Drake helmet
game_description: An elaborate and finely-crafted helm.
description: The Drake helmet is a Mountain-era heavy helmet forged from a Drake trophy and Wolf pelts. It grants natural frost resistance and is typically worn alongside the Wolf armor set.

name: Fenris hood
game_description: The eyes of the beast were wise and knowing, so that it could measure the strength of a warrior in one glance.
description: The Fenris hood is the head piece of the Fenris set, a Mountain-tier light armor crafted from Fenris hair, Wolf pelts, and a Cultist trophy. Each piece grants +3% movement speed and the full three-piece set provides +15 Fists skill and fire resistance.

name: Iron helmet
game_description: A helm of polished iron, fit for a hero.
description: The Iron helmet is the head piece of the Iron armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Swamp era. It is forged from Iron and Deer hide.

name: Leather helmet
game_description: A hood of toughened leather.
description: The Leather helmet is the head piece of the Leather armor set, an early light armor crafted at a Workbench from Deer hide. It is one of the first armor pieces Vikings can build in the Meadows.

name: Hood of Odin
game_description: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest cloth.
description: The Hood of Odin is a cosmetic helmet included with the Valheim DLC. It is crafted from Leather scraps and Coal and offers no combat bonuses, serving only as a visual flourish.

name: Padded helmet
game_description: A snug fit, finely made.
description: The Padded helmet is the head piece of the Padded armor set, the heavy armor unlocked in the Plains era. It is forged from Iron and Linen thread.

name: Root mask
game_description: Your head fits perfectly inside this knot of roots and bark.
description: The Root mask is the head piece of the Root armor set, a Swamp-era light armor crafted from Root and Ancient bark. The full set grants a +15 Bows skill bonus, making it the go-to choice for archers.

name: Troll leather helmet
game_description: Trollskin is hard to work but makes exceptional armour.
description: The Troll leather helmet is the head piece of the Troll armor set, a Black Forest-era light armor crafted from Troll hide. The full set grants a +15 Sneak skill bonus.

name: Yule hat
game_description: A red cap in the style of house gnomes.
description: The Yule hat is a cosmetic red cap in the style of Norse house gnomes. It is sold by Haldor the trader and offers no combat bonuses.

name: Dverger circlet
game_description: A portable perpetual lightsource for the dungeon explorer.
description: The Dverger circlet is a cosmetic accessory sold by Haldor the trader. It functions as a portable, perpetual light source — a cone-shaped beam that illuminates dark caves and dungeons without occupying a hand slot.

name: Wishbone
game_description: This ancient bone remembers the location of many forgotten things.
description: The Wishbone is an accessory dropped by Bonemass, the third boss of Valheim. When equipped, it pulses green particles and a ding sound near hidden objects — Muddy scrap piles in the Swamp, Silver veins in the Mountain, and Buried treasures in the Meadows. It shares its accessory slot with Megingjord and the Wisplight.

name: Blackmetal axe
game_description: A perfectly balanced axe forged from dark metal with an emerald sheen.
description: The Blackmetal axe is a Plains-tier one-handed axe forged from Black metal and Fine wood at the Forge. It deals slash and chop damage and is the first axe capable of chopping Yggdrasil shoots in the Mistlands.

name: Bronze axe
game_description: A bright and burnished blade, curved like a smile.
description: The Bronze axe is a Black Forest-era one-handed axe forged from Wood, Bronze, and Leather scraps at the Forge. It deals slash and chop damage and is the first axe capable of chopping Ancient trees in the Swamp as well as Birch and Oak trees, which yield Fine wood.

name: Flint axe
game_description: Sharper than stone.
description: The Flint axe is an early Meadows-era one-handed axe crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Flint. It deals slash and chop damage and is the typical upgrade from the Stone axe before reaching the Black Forest.

name: Iron axe
game_description: Sharp and strong, a woodcutter's friend.
description: The Iron axe is a Swamp-era one-handed axe forged from Iron and Wood. It deals slash and chop damage and can chop every tree the Bronze axe can, but with higher damage and durability, making it the natural upgrade once Iron is unlocked.

name: Stone axe
game_description: A crude axe for tree-felling.
description: The Stone axe is Valheim's starting one-handed axe, crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Stone. It deals slash and chop damage and can fell the smaller trees in the Meadows and Black Forest, but not Birch, Oak, or Ancient Trees.

name: Cultivator
game_description: A farming tool for tilling soil.
description: The Cultivator is a building tool used to plant crops and trees on cultivated ground. It is crafted at the Forge from Core wood and Bronze, and unlocks farming in the Black Forest era.

name: Fishing rod
game_description: Standard issue dvergr fishing rod.
description: The Fishing rod is a tool used to catch fish from rivers, lakes, and oceans. It can be purchased from Haldor the trader, and requires Fishing bait to function.

name: Hammer
game_description: With this to your hand, you can raise high halls and mighty fortifications.
description: The Hammer is the fundamental building tool used to place and repair every constructable piece. It is crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Stone and is one of the first items Vikings craft.

name: Hoe
game_description: A farmer's tool for working the earth.
description: The Hoe is a building tool used to flatten or raise terrain and create paths and roads. It is crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Stone and unlocks cultivated ground when used with the Cultivator.

name: Antler pickaxe
game_description: This tool is hard enough to crack even the most stubborn rocks.
description: The Antler pickaxe is Valheim's first mining tool, crafted at a Workbench from Hard antler dropped by Eikthyr. It can mine Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap piles, and Abyssal barnacles.

name: Bronze pickaxe
game_description: A good bronze pick. Can break very hard rocks.
description: The Bronze pickaxe is a Black Forest-era mining tool forged from Core wood and Bronze. It mines the same materials as the Antler pickaxe — Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap piles, and Abyssal barnacles — but with higher damage and durability.

name: Iron pickaxe
game_description: A sturdy tool of hardened iron.
description: The Iron pickaxe is a Swamp-era mining tool forged from Wood and Iron. It is the first pickaxe capable of mining Obsidian, Silver veins, and Glowing metal, in addition to everything the previous pickaxes can mine.

name: Stone pickaxe
game_description: A rock-breaker made of stone.
description: The Stone pickaxe is an unused or removed mining tool that exists in the game's internal data but does not appear in normal gameplay. It can only be obtained through the console with the spawn command.

name: Abyssal harpoon
game_description: The ocean's wrath.
description: The Abyssal harpoon is a one-handed harpoon spear forged at a Workbench from Fine wood, Chitin, and Leather scraps. Its primary use is to hook Sea Serpents from a boat and reel them in close enough to kill, after which they can be looted for Serpent meat and scales.

name: Blackmetal atgeir
game_description: A vicious hewing-axe of almost unbreakable black metal.
description: The Blackmetal atgeir is a Plains-tier two-handed polearm forged from Black metal and Fine wood at the Forge. Its primary attack deals slash and pierce damage and its spinning secondary attack hits all enemies in a wide arc, ideal for crowd control against Fulings.

name: Bronze atgeir
game_description: A true warrior's tool.
description: The Bronze atgeir is a Black Forest-era two-handed polearm forged from Bronze and Wood at the Forge. Its primary attack deals slash and pierce damage and its spinning secondary attack sweeps all nearby enemies.

name: Iron atgeir
game_description: Blood-drinker, skull-cracker, death-bringer.
description: The Iron atgeir is a Swamp-era two-handed polearm forged from Iron and Wood at the Forge. Its primary attack deals slash and pierce damage and its spinning secondary attack sweeps all nearby enemies, making it a popular crowd-control choice.

name: Battleaxe
game_description: Skull-splitter, a warrior's joy.
description: The Battleaxe is a Swamp-era two-handed axe forged from Iron, Ancient bark, and Leather scraps. It deals slash damage and can chop trees, trading the one-handed shield slot for significantly higher single-target damage.

name: Crystal battleaxe
game_description: It's see-through and tears through.
description: The Crystal battleaxe is a Mountain-era two-handed axe forged from Ancient bark, Silver, and Crystal. It deals slash and spirit damage, can chop trees, and emits a bluish-white light when wielded.

name: Crude bow
game_description: A crude but functional bow.
description: The Crude bow is Valheim's starting bow, crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Leather scraps. It is the first ranged weapon Vikings unlock and is intended to bridge the gap until a Finewood bow is available.

name: Draugr Fang bow
game_description: Dark wood strung with glistening sinew. A vicious thing.
description: The Draugr Fang bow is a Mountain-era bow crafted from Ancient bark, Silver, Deer hide, and Guck. It is the strongest standard bow in the game prior to Mistlands and is favored for its raw arrow damage.

name: Finewood bow
game_description: A simple bow of strong and supple wood.
description: The Finewood bow is a Black Forest-era bow crafted from Fine wood, Core wood, and Deer hide at a Workbench. It is a substantial upgrade over the Crude bow and is the standard bow throughout the Bronze tier.

name: Huntsman bow
game_description: Finely worked and strung. A huntsman's joy.
description: The Huntsman bow is a Swamp-era bow crafted from Fine wood, Iron, Feathers, and Deer hide. It deals more damage than the Finewood bow and is the go-to ranged weapon for Iron-tier exploration.

name: Club
game_description: A crude but useful weapon.
description: The Club is Valheim's starting one-handed blunt weapon, crafted at a Workbench from Wood. It deals blunt damage and is typically the first melee weapon Vikings craft alongside the Stone axe.

name: Fenris claw
game_description: If claws work for wolves, why not for a viking?
description: The Fenris claw is a Mountain-era fist weapon forged from Silver, Leather scraps, and a Cultist trophy. It is a dual-wielded unarmed weapon that scales with the Fists skill and synergizes with the Fenris armor set.

name: Blackmetal knife
game_description: A darkling blade. Strong and sharp.
description: The Blackmetal knife is a Plains-tier one-handed knife forged from Black metal and Fine wood. It deals pierce damage with very high backstab multipliers, making it ideal for stealth players.

name: Abyssal razor/knife
game_description: A knife from the deep.
description: The Abyssal razor is a one-handed knife crafted from Chitin, dropped from killing Leviathans with an Abyssal harpoon. It deals pierce damage and is the only weapon that uses Chitin, making it a unique Ocean-tier option.

name: Copper knife
game_description: A glittering copper knife.
description: The Copper knife is a Black Forest-era one-handed knife forged from Copper and Wood. It deals pierce damage with high backstab multipliers, making it a strong stealth weapon for the Bronze tier.

name: Flint knife
game_description: Sharpened flint. A reliable tool.
description: The Flint knife is an early Meadows-era one-handed knife crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Flint. It deals pierce damage with high backstab multipliers, making it the first reliable stealth weapon.

name: Silver knife
game_description: A savage piece of pain.
description: The Silver knife is a Mountain-era one-handed knife forged from Silver and Ancient bark. It deals pierce and spirit damage, making it especially effective against undead enemies like Draugr, Skeletons, and Wraiths.

name: Bronze mace
game_description: A headache on a stick.
description: The Bronze mace is a Black Forest-era one-handed mace forged from Bronze and Wood. It deals blunt damage and is particularly effective against armored enemies and stone constructs like the Stone Golem.

name: Iron mace
game_description: A fist-sized lump of iron on a wooden shaft.
description: The Iron mace is a Swamp-era one-handed mace forged from Iron and Wood. It deals blunt damage and is highly effective against the undead skeletons and draugr that populate Sunken Crypts.

name: Porcupine
game_description: A deadly weapon, bristling with fiendish spikes.
description: The Porcupine is a Plains-tier one-handed mace forged from Fine wood, Iron, Linen thread, and Needles. It deals a hybrid of blunt and pierce damage, making it versatile against both armored and lightly armored enemies.

name: Frostner
game_description: The dead fear silver. Remind them why.
description: Frostner is a Mountain-era one-handed mace forged from Ancient bark, Silver, Ymir flesh, and Freeze glands. It deals blunt, frost, and spirit damage, making it devastating against the undead and against cold-vulnerable enemies.

name: Banded shield
game_description: Banded with hoops of iron, a true warrior's companion.
description: The Banded shield is a Black Forest-era one-handed round shield crafted from Fine wood, Iron, and Bronze nails. It offers solid block force and is the standard upgrade from the Wood shield for the Bronze tier.

name: Black metal shield
game_description: Fashioned from the strongest metal, able to turn even the deadliest blades.
description: The Black metal shield is a Plains-tier one-handed round shield forged from Black metal, Fine wood, and Iron. It provides the highest block force of any non-Ashlands round shield.

name: Black metal tower shield
game_description: A tower shield of gleaming dark metal.
description: The Black metal tower shield is a Plains-tier tower shield forged from Black metal, Fine wood, and Iron. It offers the largest block force of any non-Ashlands shield but slows movement significantly.

name: Bone tower shield
game_description: The bones of dead warriors make for a good protection.
description: The Bone tower shield is a Black Forest-era tower shield crafted from Wood and Bone fragments. It is an early-game tower shield option for players who prefer block-and-bash defense.

name: Bronze buckler
game_description: A shield of burnished bronze, good to turn a blade or two.
description: The Bronze buckler is a Black Forest-era one-handed buckler shield forged from Bronze, Fine wood, and Deer hide. It is a small, fast shield that boosts parry damage at the cost of lower block force.

name: Iron buckler
game_description: Its lightness and curved center makes it excellent for deflecting attacks.
description: The Iron buckler is a Swamp-era one-handed buckler shield forged from Iron, Fine wood, and Deer hide. It boosts parry damage, rewarding precise timing over raw block force.

name: Iron shield
game_description: An iron sword-breaker, tile of the battle-wall.
description: The Iron shield is a Swamp-era one-handed round shield forged from Iron, Fine wood, and Bronze nails. It offers the highest block force at the Iron tier without the movement penalty of a tower shield.

name: Iron tower shield
game_description: A tall shield of strong iron.
description: The Iron tower shield is a Swamp-era tower shield forged from Iron, Fine wood, and Bronze nails. It offers very high block force at the cost of significant movement speed penalty.

name: Knight shield
game_description: A wooden shield reinforced with iron. UNUSED
description: The Knight shield is a Swamp-era one-handed shield forged from Wood and Iron at the Forge. It is a balanced round shield with strong block force for the Iron tier.

name: Serpent scale shield
game_description: A sturdy shield of overlapping scales.
description: The Serpent scale shield is a one-handed round shield forged from Serpent scales, dropped from Serpents in the Ocean biome during storms. It is a rare endgame round shield with very high block force.

name: Silver shield
game_description: A shield of radiant silver.
description: The Silver shield is a Mountain-era one-handed round shield forged from Silver, Fine wood, and Iron. It offers high block force for the Mountain tier and pairs well with the Wolf armor set.

name: Wood shield
game_description: A simple wooden shield.
description: The Wood shield is Valheim's starting one-handed shield, crafted at a Workbench from Wood. It is the first shield Vikings unlock and offers basic protection for the Meadows.

name: Wood tower shield
game_description: A rough but heavy wooden shield.
description: The Wood tower shield is an early Meadows-era tower shield crafted from Wood. It offers more block force than the round Wood shield but applies a significant movement speed penalty.

name: Iron sledge
game_description: A mighty hammer, worthy of a champion.
description: The Iron sledge is a Swamp-era two-handed sledgehammer forged from Iron, Ancient bark, Ymir flesh, and a Draugr Elite trophy. It deals heavy blunt damage in an area-of-effect around the impact point, ideal for groups of armored enemies.

name: Stagbreaker
game_description: A weapon worthy of the Gods! If you get hit with this, you'll know it...
description: Stagbreaker is a Black Forest-era two-handed sledgehammer crafted from Core wood, Deer trophies, and Leather scraps. It deals blunt and pierce damage in a wide area-of-effect on impact, ideal for clearing groups of weaker enemies.

name: Bronze spear
game_description: A sturdy spear with a head of burnished bronze.
description: The Bronze spear is a Black Forest-era one-handed spear forged from Bronze, Wood, and Leather scraps. It deals pierce damage and can be thrown as a ranged attack.

name: Ancient bark spear
game_description: Despite its gnarled look, this spear is strong and perfectly balanced.
description: The Ancient bark spear is a Black Forest-era one-handed spear crafted from Ancient bark, Iron, and Deer hide. It deals pierce damage and can be thrown, offering a hybrid melee/ranged role.

name: Flint spear
game_description: If your eye marks a thing for death, let your arm send the messenger.
description: The Flint spear is an early Meadows-era one-handed spear crafted at a Workbench from Wood and Flint. It deals pierce damage and can be thrown as a ranged attack, making it the first thrown weapon Vikings unlock.

name: Fang spear
game_description: Even in death, the wolf's tooth aches for flesh.
description: The Fang spear is a Mountain-era one-handed spear forged from Ancient bark, Leather scraps, and Wolf fangs. It deals pierce damage and can be thrown as a ranged attack, with higher damage than the Ancient bark spear.

name: Blackmetal sword
game_description: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.
description: The Blackmetal sword is a Plains-tier one-handed sword forged from Black metal, Fine wood, and Linen thread. It deals slash damage and is the strongest standard one-handed sword prior to the Mistlands.

name: Bronze sword
game_description: Blood-drinker. A thirsty friend.
description: The Bronze sword is a Black Forest-era one-handed sword forged from Bronze, Wood, and Leather scraps at the Forge. It deals slash damage and is the typical Bronze-tier upgrade from no sword at all.

name: Cheat Sword
game_description: Cheater!
description: The Cheat Sword is an admin/debug weapon not intended for normal gameplay. It deals massive damage to instantly kill most enemies and can only be obtained through the console with the spawn command.

name: Iron sword
game_description: The straight line between life and death runs along the edge of this blade.
description: The Iron sword is a Swamp-era one-handed sword forged from Iron, Wood, and Leather scraps at the Forge. It deals slash damage and is the standard Iron-tier sword.

name: Dyrnwyn
game_description: Unsheathed, it sizzles and spits with deathless fire, an impossible blade.
description: Dyrnwyn is a DLC one-handed sword that deals slash and fire damage, sizzling with flame when unsheathed. It is a cosmetic-tier bonus item available to early supporters and Cross-the-Ages collectors.

name: Silver sword
game_description: Purest of metals, nothing unclean can abide its touch.
description: The Silver sword is a Mountain-era one-handed sword forged from Silver, Wood, and Leather scraps at the Forge. It deals slash and spirit damage, making it especially effective against undead enemies.

name: Tankard
game_description: Skål!
description: The Tankard is a one-handed drinking vessel crafted from Fine wood and Tin. It is purely a flavor item used to drink mead with friends and offers no combat function despite its weapon classification.

name: Mead horn of Odin
game_description: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest drinks.
description: The Mead horn of Odin is a DLC drinking vessel included with the Valheim early-supporter rewards. Like the Tankard, it is a purely flavor item with no combat function.

name: Torch
game_description: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.
description: The Torch is a Meadows-era one-handed lightsource crafted from Wood and Resin at a Workbench. It deals blunt and fire damage in melee and drives away the darkness, making it especially useful inside dungeons and against fire-vulnerable enemies.

name: Bronzehead arrow
game_description: Sharper than flint. A sleek messenger of death.
description: Bronzehead arrows are a Black Forest-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, and Bronze. Each arrow deals 32 Pierce damage and is the standard upgrade from Flinthead arrows.

name: Fire arrow
game_description: This arrow burns whatever it pierces.
description: Fire arrows are a fire-damage ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Resin, and Feathers. Each arrow deals 11 Pierce + 22 Fire damage, making them especially effective against frost-vulnerable enemies like Moder, Drakes, and Wolves.

name: Flinthead arrow
game_description: A hide-breaker with a head of flint.
description: Flinthead arrows are an early Meadows-era ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, and Flint. Each arrow deals 27 Pierce damage and is the typical upgrade from Wood arrows.

name: Frost arrow
game_description: A shard of piercing ice.
description: Frost arrows are a Mountain-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, Obsidian, and Freeze glands. Each arrow deals 26 Pierce + 52 Frost damage, making them effective against fire-vulnerable enemies and slow-moving foes.

name: Ironhead arrow
game_description: Capped with iron and flighted with dark feathers.
description: Ironhead arrows are a Swamp-tier ammunition forged at a Forge from Wood, Feathers, and Iron. Each arrow deals 42 Pierce damage and is the standard upgrade from Bronzehead arrows.

name: Needle arrow
game_description: The final stitch.
description: Needle arrows are a Plains-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Needles dropped by Deathsquitos. Each arrow deals 62 Pierce damage, making them the highest pure-pierce arrow available before the Mistlands.

name: Obsidian arrow
game_description: A sliver of darkness.
description: Obsidian arrows are a Mountain-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, and Obsidian. Each arrow deals 52 Pierce damage, offering pure piercing power without elemental damage.

name: Poison arrow
game_description: A bitter sting from afar.
description: Poison arrows are a Swamp-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, Obsidian, and Ooze. Each arrow deals 26 Pierce + 52 Poison damage, making them potent against most non-undead enemies.

name: Silver arrow
game_description: A needle to calm restless spirits.
description: Silver arrows are a Mountain-tier ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Feathers, Obsidian, and Silver. Each arrow deals 52 Pierce + 20 Spirit damage, making them especially effective against undead enemies like Draugr, Skeletons, and Wraiths.

name: Wood arrow
game_description: An arrow of sharpened wood.
description: Wood arrows are the basic starter ammunition crafted at a Workbench from Wood. Each arrow deals 22 Pierce damage and is the first ranged ammunition Vikings unlock alongside the Crude bow.

name: Abomination trophy
game_description: A tangled mess of roots and bark.
description: The Abomination trophy is a rare drop from the Abomination, a slow tree-like creature found in the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Blob trophy
game_description: A smelly lump of sticky matter.
description: The Blob trophy is a rare drop from the Blob, a small poisonous slime found in the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Boar trophy
game_description: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house.
description: The Boar trophy is a rare drop from Boars, common tameable creatures found in the Meadows. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Bonemass trophy
game_description:
Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
description: The Bonemass trophy is a unique drop from Bonemass, the third boss of Valheim. Hanging it at a Forsaken Altar grants the player Bonemass's Forsaken power, which increases resistance to blunt, slash, and pierce damage and eliminates stamina cost from blocking.

name: Deathsquito trophy
game_description: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead.
description: The Deathsquito trophy is a rare drop from the Deathsquito, a fragile but lethal flying insect found in the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Deer trophy
game_description: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.
description: The Deer trophy is a drop from Deer, passive creatures found in the Meadows. Two Deer trophies are required to summon Valheim's first boss, Eikthyr, by placing them on his Forsaken Altar.

name: Moder trophy
game_description:
The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
description: The Moder trophy is a unique drop from Moder, the fourth boss of Valheim. Hanging it at a Forsaken Altar grants the player Moder's Forsaken power, which increases maximum carry weight, movement speed, and frost resistance.

name: Draugr trophy
game_description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...
description: The Draugr trophy is a rare drop from Draugrs, undead Vikings found in the Swamp. Both male and female Draugr variants can drop this trophy, which can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Draugr Elite trophy
game_description: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.
description: The Draugr Elite trophy is a rare drop from the Draugr Elite, a powerful undead warrior wielding a two-handed axe in the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Eikthyr trophy
game_description:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
description: The Eikthyr trophy is a unique drop from Eikthyr, the first boss of Valheim. Hanging it at a Forsaken Altar grants the player Eikthyr's Forsaken power, which reduces stamina drain from running, jumping, and swimming.

name: Fenring trophy
game_description: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.
description: The Fenring trophy is a rare drop from the Fenring, a fast wolf-humanoid encountered in the Mountains at night. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Troll trophy
game_description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
description: The Troll trophy is a rare drop from Trolls, large humanoids found in the Black Forest. Both Forest and Frost troll variants drop this trophy, which can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Fuling trophy
game_description: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.
description: The Fuling trophy is a rare drop from Fulings, the small goblin-like enemies found in the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Fuling berserker trophy
game_description: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.
description: The Fuling berserker trophy is a rare drop from the Fuling berserker, a powerful goblin warrior dual-wielding axes in the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Yagluth trophy
game_description:
The crownless head of a dead king.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
description: The Yagluth trophy is a unique drop from Yagluth, the fifth boss of Valheim. Hanging it at a Forsaken Altar grants the player Yagluth's Forsaken power, which increases all damage dealt and grants lightning resistance.

name: Fuling shaman trophy
game_description: It shall cast no more spells against you.
description: The Fuling shaman trophy is a rare drop from the Fuling shaman, a goblin spellcaster that heals allies and summons fireballs in the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Greydwarf trophy
game_description: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf.
description: The Greydwarf trophy is a rare drop from the Greydwarf, the most common enemy of the Black Forest. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Greydwarf Brute trophy
game_description: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body.
description: The Greydwarf Brute trophy is a rare drop from the Greydwarf Brute, a larger and stronger melee variant found in the Black Forest. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Greydwarf Shaman trophy
game_description: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...
description: The Greydwarf Shaman trophy is a rare drop from the Greydwarf Shaman, a spellcaster that heals and slows enemies in the Black Forest. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Growth trophy
game_description: A black and sticky mess.
description: The Growth trophy is a rare drop from the Growth, a tar-based slime creature that emerges from Tar pits in the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Drake trophy
game_description: Still cold to the touch.
description: The Drake trophy is a rare drop from Drakes, the small frost dragons that fly over the Mountains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Leech trophy
game_description: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.
description: The Leech trophy is a rare drop from Leeches, the aquatic bloodsuckers found in the murky waters of the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Lox trophy
game_description: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.
description: The Lox trophy is a rare drop from the Lox, a large tameable beast that roams the Plains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Neck trophy
game_description: The beady eyes and razor sharp teeth belie the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard.
description: The Neck trophy is a rare drop from Necks, small lizard-like creatures found near water in the Meadows. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Stone Golem trophy
game_description: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.
description: The Stone Golem trophy is a rare drop from the Stone Golem, a massive rock creature found in the Mountains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Serpent trophy
game_description: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright.
description: The Serpent trophy is a rare drop from the Serpent, a massive sea creature encountered in the Ocean during storms. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Skeleton trophy
game_description: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.
description: The Skeleton trophy is a rare drop from Skeletons, undead enemies found in the Black Forest and inside Burial Chambers. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Rancid Remains trophy
game_description: A rank and rotten skull. You're not sure why you kept it...
description: The Rancid Remains trophy is a rare drop from Rancid Remains, the poisonous skeleton variant found inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Surtling trophy
game_description: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smoulders like an ember.
description: The Surtling trophy is a rare drop from Surtlings, the small fire creatures spawned from Surtling cores in the Swamp, at Fire Geysers, and across the Ashlands. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: The Elder trophy
game_description:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
description: The Elder trophy is a unique drop from The Elder, the second boss of Valheim. Hanging it at a Forsaken Altar grants the player The Elder's Forsaken power, which boosts health regeneration and damage dealt to trees and rocks.

name: Wolf trophy
game_description: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.
description: The Wolf trophy is a rare drop from Wolves, aggressive pack hunters native to the Mountains. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Wraith trophy
game_description: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.
description: The Wraith trophy is a rare drop from Wraiths, ghostly humanoids that spawn at night in the Swamp. Trophies can be displayed on item stands as wall decoration.

name: Fire resistance barley wine
game_description: Fortifies you against fire.
description: Fire resistance barley wine grants temporary fire resistance for 10 minutes, with a 10-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Barley wine base in a Fermenter for about two in-game days, and is the primary defense for venturing into Yagluth fights and the Ashlands.

name: Barley wine base: Fire resistance
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Barley wine base is the unfermented intermediate for Fire resistance barley wine, crafted at a Cauldron from Barley and Cloudberries. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Fire resistance barley wines.

name: Mead base: Frost resistance
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Frost resistance is the unfermented intermediate for Frost resistance mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Thistle, Bloodbag, and a Greydwarf eye. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Frost resistance meads.

name: Mead base: Medium healing
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Medium healing is the unfermented intermediate for Medium healing mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Bloodbag, Raspberries, and a Dandelion. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Medium healing meads.

name: Mead base: Minor healing
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Minor healing is the unfermented intermediate for Minor healing mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Blueberries, Raspberries, and a Dandelion. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Minor healing meads.

name: Mead base: Poison resistance
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Poison resistance is the unfermented intermediate for Poison resistance mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Thistle, Neck tail, and Coal. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Poison resistance meads.

name: Mead base: Medium stamina
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Medium stamina is the unfermented intermediate for Medium stamina mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Cloudberries, and Yellow mushrooms. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Medium stamina meads.

name: Mead base: Minor stamina
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Minor stamina is the unfermented intermediate for Minor stamina mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Raspberries, and Yellow mushrooms. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Minor stamina meads.

name: Mead base: Tasty
game_description: Needs to be fermented.
description: Mead base: Tasty is the unfermented intermediate for Tasty mead, crafted at a Cauldron from Honey, Raspberries, and Blueberries. Place it in a Fermenter for about two in-game days to brew six Tasty meads.

name: Frost resistance mead
game_description: Protects against the cold.
description: Frost resistance mead grants temporary frost resistance for 10 minutes, with a 10-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Frost resistance in a Fermenter, and is essential for surviving cold exposure in the Mountains.

name: Medium healing mead
game_description: Restores health.
description: Medium healing mead restores 75 health over 10 seconds with a two-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Medium healing in a Fermenter for about two in-game days.

name: Minor healing mead
game_description: Restores health.
description: Minor healing mead restores 50 health over 10 seconds with a two-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Minor healing in a Fermenter and is typically the first healing mead Vikings unlock.

name: Poison resistance mead
game_description: Fortifies you against poison.
description: Poison resistance mead grants temporary poison resistance for 10 minutes, with a 10-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Poison resistance in a Fermenter, and is crucial for surviving Leeches, Blobs, and the Swamp in general.

name: Medium stamina mead
game_description: Restores stamina.
description: Medium stamina mead restores 160 stamina over 2 seconds with a two-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Medium stamina in a Fermenter for about two in-game days.

name: Minor stamina mead
game_description: Restores stamina.
description: Minor stamina mead restores 80 stamina over 2 seconds with a two-minute cooldown after drinking. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Minor stamina in a Fermenter for about two in-game days.

name: Tasty mead
game_description: The nectar of the Gods, divine mead.
description: Tasty mead applies a 10-second buff that reduces health regeneration by 50% but doubles stamina regeneration, with a 10-second cooldown. It is brewed by fermenting Mead base: Tasty in a Fermenter for about two in-game days.

name: Acorn
game_description: Plant them to grow an oak tree.
description: Acorns are tree seeds dropped by chopping Oak trees in the Meadows. They can be planted on cultivated ground using the Cultivator to grow a new Oak tree, which will eventually yield Fine wood when felled.

name: Amber
game_description: <color=yellow>Valuable</color>
description: Amber is a Valuable item found inside chests and treasure piles in the Meadows, Black Forest, and Swamp. It has no crafting use and is sold to Haldor the trader for Coins.

name: Amber Pearl
game_description: <color=yellow>Valuable</color>
description: Amber Pearl is a rarer Valuable item found inside chests and treasure piles, especially in the Black Forest and beyond. Like Amber, it is primarily sold to Haldor the trader for Coins.

name: Ancient Seed
game_description: Held against your ear, you hear tiny whisperings within...
description: An Ancient Seed is a rare drop from Greydwarf Brutes, Greydwarf Shamans, and crows attacking Greydwarf nests, plus dungeon chests. Three Ancient seeds are required to summon The Elder, Valheim's second boss, on his Forsaken Altar.

name: Barley
game_description: A bundle of barley.
description: Barley is a Plains-era crop harvested by picking cultivated barley plants. It can be ground at a Windmill into Barley flour, which is used to bake Bread, Lox pie, and Fish wraps.

name: Barley flour
game_description: Great for baking bread.
description: Barley flour is produced by placing Barley into a Windmill. It is the key ingredient in Bread dough, Lox pie, and other Plains-tier baked recipes.

name: Beech seeds
game_description: Plant them to grow a beech tree.
description: Beech seeds are tree seeds gathered by chopping Beech trees or their saplings. They can be planted with the Cultivator to grow new Beech trees, which yield Wood when felled.

name: Bilebag
game_description: Caustic bile drawn from the corpse of a gjall.
description: A Bilebag is a Mistlands material dropped by Gjall, the floating mosquito-like creatures of the Mistlands. It is the key ingredient for Bile bombs, a powerful Mistlands throwable explosive.

name: Birch seeds
game_description: Plant them to grow a birch tree.
description: Birch seeds are tree seeds gathered by chopping Birch trees. They can be planted with the Cultivator to grow new Birch trees, which yield Fine wood when felled with a Bronze axe or better.

name: Black Core
game_description: Filled to the brim with ancient power.
description: A Black core is a Mistlands material found inside Infested Mines, usually on stands in hidden rooms. Black cores are required to build Mistlands-tier crafting stations like the Black forge, Galdr table, and Eitr refinery.

name: Black Marble
game_description: A block of solid stone, seamed with shifting colors.
description: Black marble is a Mistlands building material harvested from black marble formations near Dvergr structures. It is mined with a Black metal pickaxe and used to build the Mistlands-tier ornate Black marble pieces.

name: Black metal
game_description: A heavy bar of dark metal.
description: Black metal is a refined Plains-tier ingot smelted from Black metal scrap at a Smelter, using Coal as fuel. It is the key material for Plains-tier weapons, armor, and tools, including the Blackmetal sword, Porcupine, and Black metal pickaxe.

name: Black metal scrap
game_description: A twisted hunk of dark metal.
description: Black metal scrap is the unrefined form of Black metal, dropped by Fulings, Fuling berserkers, and Fuling shamans in the Plains. Smelting four scraps at a Smelter yields one Black metal ingot.

name: Bloodbag
game_description: The contents of a leech. Ick!
description: A Bloodbag is dropped by Leeches in the Swamp. It is a key ingredient for several Swamp/Mountain-tier recipes, including Blood pudding, Frostner, Medium healing mead, and Frost resistance mead.

name: Blood pudding
game_description: It's bloody tasty.
description: Blood pudding is a Mountain-tier Stamina food cooked at a Cauldron from Thistle, Bloodbag, and Barley flour. It is one of the higher-tier stamina foods unlocked before Plains-tier cuisine.

name: Blueberries
game_description: Tiny but tasty.
description: Blueberries are a Black Forest berry picked from glowing Blueberry bushes. They are a balanced food that provides modest health and stamina, and are used in several Mountain-tier recipes like Eyescream and Tasty mead.

name: Boar jerky
game_description: Lean and salty.
description: Boar jerky is a Mountain-tier balanced food cooked at a Cauldron from Boar meat and Raspberries. It is shelf-stable and provides a long-lasting health and stamina buff.

name: Bone fragments
game_description: A pile of shattered bones.
description: Bone fragments are common drops from all Skeletons in the Black Forest and Burial Chambers. They are used as a building material in many early structures and as a crafting ingredient for capes, the Stagbreaker, and several other early items.

name: Bread
game_description: A tasty loaf of bread.
description: Bread is a Plains-tier Stamina food baked at a Stone Oven from Bread dough. It restores generous stamina and is a staple food for the Plains and Mistlands eras.

name: Bread dough
game_description: Ready for the oven.
description: Bread dough is the unbaked intermediate for Bread, prepared at a Cauldron from Barley flour. Place the dough in a Stone Oven to bake it into Bread.

name: Bronze
game_description: A strong alloy of copper and tin.
description: Bronze is an alloy ingot smelted from Copper and Tin in a Forge — one Bronze requires two Copper and one Tin. It is the key Black Forest-tier metal used in Bronze weapons, armor, the Cultivator, and many other early tools.

name: Bronze nails
game_description: Used in construction of ships and furniture.
description: Bronze nails are construction fasteners forged from Bronze at a Forge — one Bronze produces ten Bronze nails. They are used in many ship and furniture recipes, most notably the Karve longship.

name: Carapace
game_description: A plate of chitinous armour.
description: Carapace is a Mistlands material dropped by Seekers and Seeker soldiers. It is the central material for the Mistlands-tier Carapace armor set, Carapace shield, and Carapace buckler.

name: Carrot
game_description: An orange treat.
description: Carrots are a Black Forest-tier crop grown from Carrot seeds on cultivated ground. They are used in Carrot soup and other recipes, and provide stamina when eaten raw.

name: Carrot soup
game_description: A warm tasty soup made of mostly carrots.
description: Carrot soup is a Black Forest-tier Stamina food cooked at a Cauldron from Carrots and a Mushroom. It is one of the first cooked foods that provides significant stamina, unlocked once Carrots are growing.

name: Cloudberries
game_description: The gold of the forest.
description: Cloudberries are a golden Plains berry picked from cloudberry bushes. They are a Stamina food that's also used in Medium stamina mead, Boar jerky, and several Mistlands recipes.

name: Cooked deer meat
game_description: All that running paid off.
description: Cooked deer meat is the cooked form of Deer meat, prepared on a Cooking station over a fire. It is a balanced food that provides solid health and stamina early in the game.

name: Cooked lox meat
game_description: A great hunk of tender meat, food fit for Valhalla!
description: Cooked lox meat is the cooked form of Lox meat, prepared on an Iron cooking station over a Hearth. It is a powerful Plains-tier Health food.

name: Cooked boar meat
game_description: An earthly taste.
description: Cooked boar meat is the cooked form of Boar meat, prepared on a Cooking station over a fire. It is the earliest cooked food Vikings can craft.

name: Cooked wolf meat
game_description: A wild taste.
description: Cooked wolf meat is the cooked form of Wolf meat, prepared on a Cooking station over a fire. It is a Mountain-tier Health food.

name: Carrot seeds
game_description: Plant these if you like carrots...
description: Using the Cultivator, carrot seeds can be sown to yield a single carrot.

name: Chitin
game_description: A shard of crustacean shell.
description: Chitin is dropped from Sea Serpents when they are harpooned with the Abyssal harpoon and dragged ashore. It is the key material for Chitin armor and the Abyssal razor knife.

name: Coal
game_description: A lump of coal.
description: Coal is produced by burning Wood in a Charcoal kiln or by collecting it from a Cooking station's burnt food. It is used as fuel in the Smelter, Blast furnace, and Forge, and as an ingredient in some crafts.

name: Coins
game_description: <color=yellow>Valuable</color>
description: Coins are Valheim's currency, found inside chests, dropped from Fuling enemies, and earned by selling Valuables (Amber, Rubies, etc.) to Haldor the trader. They are used to buy items from Haldor, Hildir, and Bog Witch.

name: Copper
game_description: A bar of pure copper ready to be worked.
description: Copper is a Black Forest-tier refined ingot smelted from Copper ore at a Smelter using Coal as fuel. It is alloyed with Tin to produce Bronze, the key Black Forest-tier metal.

name: Copper ore
game_description: Unrefined copper. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
description: Copper ore is the unrefined form of Copper, mined from Copper deposit boulders in the Black Forest using an Antler pickaxe or better. Smelt it in a Smelter to produce Copper ingots.

name: Swamp key
game_description: Partly covered in caked mud, it smells foetid.
description: The Swamp key is a unique drop from defeating The Elder, Valheim's second boss. It is used to unlock the iron-grated doors of Sunken Crypts in the Swamp, granting access to Iron scrap inside.

name: Crystal
game_description: A shard of crystal from deep within the earth.
description: Crystal is a Mountain-tier material dropped by Stone Golems when their crystal protrusions are mined. It is used to craft the Crystal battleaxe and the Crystal walls and floors.

name: Dandelion
game_description: Some call it a weed, but it's pretty nonetheless.
description: Dandelions are bright yellow flowers picked from Dandelion plants in the Meadows. They are used in Queen's jam, Minor healing mead, and Medium healing mead recipes.

name: Deer hide
game_description: A cleaned hide from a deer.
description: Deer hide is a hide dropped by Deer in the Meadows. It is one of Valheim's most-used early materials, required for the entire Leather set, the Knife, the Hammer, capes, and many more crafts.

name: Deer meat
description: Deer meat is the raw meat dropped by Deer in the Meadows. Cook it on a Cooking station to produce Cooked deer meat, an early-game balanced food.

name: Deer stew
game_description: Fall-apart tender.
description: Deer stew is a Black Forest-tier Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Deer meat, Carrots, and Blueberries. It restores generous health and is one of the early tier health-focused foods.

name: Dragon egg
game_description: Far heavier than it looks, with a faint humming sound from within.
description: A Dragon egg is a glowing purple egg gathered from Drake nests atop Mountains. Each egg weighs 200, so only one can be carried at a time without external help. Three eggs are required to summon Moder, Valheim's fourth boss.

name: Dragon tear
game_description: The last frozen tear of a dragon, pulsating with mysterious energy.
description: A Dragon tear is a unique drop from defeating Moder, the fourth boss. It is required to build the Artisan table — gating the Windmill, Spinning wheel, and Blast furnace behind defeating Moder.

name: Sealbreaker fragment
game_description: A fragment of a Dvergr sealbreaker.
description: A Sealbreaker fragment is a Mistlands quest item gathered from Dvergr camps and Infested Mines. Multiple fragments are required to assemble the Sealbreaker, which is needed to summon The Queen, the sixth boss.

name: Refined Eitr
game_description: This is the stuff of life, the poison that consumes itself. The Dvergr refine it to use in their esoteric designs.
description: Eitr is the Mistlands magic-tier crafting material produced at the Eitr refinery from Soft tissue and Sap. It is used to craft Eitr-weave armor and most Mistlands magic weapons, and lends its name to the Eitr resource pool that powers those weapons.

name: Ancient bark
game_description: An ancient and sturdy material.
description: Ancient bark is a Swamp-era material gathered by chopping Ancient trees with a Bronze axe or better. It is used in many Iron-tier recipes including the Battleaxe, Iron sledge, Karve and Longship.

name: Entrails
game_description: A slimy length of something's insides.
description: Entrails are dropped by Draugrs in the Swamp. They are used to cook Sausages, a Swamp-tier Health food, and as a building decoration ingredient.

name: Eyescream
game_description: Crispy cool and creamy.
description: Eyescream is a Mountain-tier Stamina food cooked at a Cauldron from Freeze glands and Blueberries. The cold gland keeps it perfectly chilled, providing a balanced stamina/health buff.

name: Feathers
game_description: A small pile of feathers.
description: Feathers are a common drop from birds (Crows and Seagulls) and Drakes. They are used to craft arrows, the Feather cape, and several decoration recipes.

name: Fine wood
game_description: High quality wood for fine carpentry.
description: Fine wood is high-quality timber obtained by chopping Birch and Oak trees with a Bronze axe or better. It is the key Black Forest-tier wood, used in the Karve, the Finewood bow, fine furniture, and many more recipes.

name: Fir cone
game_description: Plant it to grow a fir tree.
description: Fir cones are tree seeds gathered by chopping Fir trees in the Black Forest. They can be planted with the Cultivator to grow new Fir trees, which yield Wood, Resin, and more Fir cones when felled.

name: Cooked fish
game_description: A tasty side of smoked fish.
description: Cooked fish is the cooked form of Raw fish, prepared on a Cooking station. It is a balanced food that provides modest health and stamina at any progression tier.

name: Raw fish
game_description: A good catch.
description: Raw fish is caught using a Fishing rod baited with Fishing bait in rivers, lakes, or oceans. It can be cooked on a Cooking station to produce Cooked fish or combined with Bread to make Fish wraps.

name: Fish wraps
game_description: Bread and fish, what more to wish?
description: Fish wraps are a Plains-tier Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Bread and Cooked fish. They are a high-tier balanced food that pairs cooked fish with a fresh-baked wrap.

name: Fishing bait
game_description: Common dvergr fishing bait. Fishing rod sold separately.
description: Fishing bait is consumed when casting a Fishing rod — one bait per cast. It is sold by Haldor the trader and (in newer updates) by Hildir, providing the essential consumable for fishing.

name: Flametal
game_description: A withered metal from ancient times. No one knows what it was once used for.
description: Flametal is the refined Ashlands ingot smelted from Flametal ore in a Blast furnace using Coal as fuel. It is the highest-tier metal in the game and the key material for Ashlands weapons, armor, and tools.

name: Flametal ore
game_description: A withered metal from ancient times. No one knows what it was once used for.
description: Flametal ore is the unrefined form of Flametal, mined from Flametal ore veins in the Ashlands using a Black metal pickaxe. It is also found inside Charred Fortress chests, by destroying Dvergr crates, and by fishing Magmafish.

name: Flax
game_description: Unspun fibers from a flax plant.
description: Flax is a Plains-era crop harvested by picking cultivated flax plants. It is spun at the Spinning wheel into Linen thread, the key material for the Padded armor set, Linen cape, and Porcupine.

name: Flint
game_description: Can be shaped into sharp blades.
description: Flint is a stone material picked up from beaches and shorelines across the Meadows. It is used in early-game tools like the Flint axe, Flint knife, and Flint spear, plus arrows.

name: Freeze gland
game_description: This mysterious organ keeps a perfect temperature.
description: Freeze glands are dropped by Drakes in the Mountains. They are used in Frostner, Frost arrows, Eyescream, and the Spinning wheel.

name: Blood clot
game_description: Be careful not to puncture this while you carry it...
description: A Blood clot is a Plains-era material dropped by Deathsquitos. It is used in Major healing mead and several Plains-tier recipes that need a stronger blood ingredient than the Swamp Bloodbag.

name: Greydwarf eye
game_description: The milky eyeball of a Greydwarf.
description: Greydwarf eyes are common drops from Greydwarves, Greydwarf brutes, and Greydwarf shamans in the Black Forest. They are used in the Hammer recipe, portals, Frost resistance mead, and the Adze workbench upgrade.

name: Guck
game_description: It smells like fermented fish.
description: Guck is a sticky green material harvested from Gucksacks growing on Ancient trees in the Swamp. It is required for Mountain-tier crafts including the Draugr Fang bow and Root armor.

name: Hard antler
game_description: A piece of very hard antlers.
description: Hard antler is a unique drop from defeating Eikthyr. It is required to craft the Antler pickaxe — Valheim's first mining tool — making the boss kill a hard gate on accessing Copper and Tin.

name: Honey
game_description: Sweet and tasty.
description: Honey is produced by Beehives placed outdoors with clear cells around them. It is used in nearly every mead recipe and in food recipes like Honey glazed chicken.

name: Iron
game_description: A bar of pure iron ready to be worked.
description: Iron is a Swamp-era refined ingot smelted from Iron scrap at a Smelter using Coal as fuel. It is the key material for Iron-tier weapons, armor, tools, and many advanced crafting stations like the Stonecutter.

name: Iron nails
game_description: Needed for advanced construction projects.
description: Iron nails are construction fasteners forged from Iron at a Forge — one Iron produces ten Iron nails. They are used in advanced ship and furniture recipes, including the Longship.

name: Iron ore
game_description: Unrefined iron. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
description: Iron ore is an uncommon Iron source obtained as a bonus drop when fishing for Giant herring. It is refined into Iron at a Smelter using Coal. The standard Swamp Iron source is Iron scrap from Muddy scrap piles; both ores refine into the same Iron ingot.

name: Scrap iron
game_description: It's old and rusty but can be smelted and used again.
description: Iron scrap is the rusted Iron form mined from Muddy scrap piles inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Smelting it in a Smelter produces Iron, the key Swamp-era metal.

name: Leather scraps
game_description: A small pile of leather scraps.
description: Leather scraps are a common drop from Boars and Necks in the Meadows. They are used in nearly every early armor and weapon recipe, including the Rag set, Hammer, and Cape of Odin.

name: Linen thread
game_description: A fine linen thread made out of a strong flax filament.
description: Linen thread is spun at a Spinning wheel from Flax. It is a Plains-tier material used in the Padded armor set, Linen cape, Porcupine, and Blackmetal sword.

name: Lox meat
game_description: A raw slab of marbled meat.
description: Lox meat is dropped by Lox in the Plains. It is cooked on an Iron cooking station to produce Cooked lox meat, one of the strongest Plains-tier Health foods.

name: Lox pelt
game_description: A heavy pelt of thick, musty fur.
description: A Lox pelt is dropped by Lox in the Plains. It is a Plains-tier material used to craft the Lox cape, which grants frost resistance.

name: Lox meat pie
game_description: Break the crust to release a cloud of fragrant steam. Delicious!
description: Lox meat pie is a Plains-tier Health food baked in a Stone Oven from Lox meat, Cloudberries, and Barley flour. It is one of the highest-tier health foods before Mistlands cuisine.

name: Mandible
game_description: The hand of man could hardly design a more perfect weapon.
description: A Mandible is a Mistlands material dropped by Seekers. It is used to craft Mistwalker, Krom, and several other Mistlands weapons that scale with Eitr or magic.

name: Minced Meat Sauce
game_description: Chunks of goodness in a thick gravy.
description: Minced meat sauce is a Black Forest-tier Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Raw meat (any kind), Carrots, and Mushrooms. It restores solid health and is a staple of Iron-tier cooking.

name: Mushroom
game_description: Bounty of the forest.
description: Common Mushrooms are gathered from glowing pickable spawn points in the Meadows and Black Forest. They provide a small balanced food buff and are used in Minced meat sauce, Carrot soup, and other recipes.

name: Blue mushroom
game_description: Glows with a soft blue hue.
description: Blue mushrooms are gathered from glowing pickable spawn points typically found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. They are used in Mountain-tier food recipes like Eyescream and Bukeperries.

name: Yellow mushroom
game_description: An energetic glowing mushroom.
description: Yellow mushrooms are gathered from glowing pickable spawn points in the Black Forest. They are used in Minor stamina mead and Medium stamina mead.

name: Neck tail
game_description: Inedible when raw, but proves to be quite a tasty snack if cooked.
description: A Neck tail is dropped by killing Necks, the small lizard creatures found in shallow water across the Meadows. Cooking it on a Cooking station produces Grilled neck tail, a balanced early-game food.

name: Grilled neck tail
game_description: This savoury, charcoal-grilled meat has a slight aroma of seaweed and grass.
description: Grilled neck tail is the cooked form of Neck tail, prepared on a Cooking station. It is a balanced early food that provides modest health and stamina.

name: Needle
game_description: The pointy end of a Deathsquito.
description: A Needle is a barbed spike dropped by Deathsquitos in the Plains. It is the key material for Needle arrows and the Porcupine mace.

name: Obsidian
game_description: Dark volcanic glass.
description: Obsidian is dark volcanic glass mined from Obsidian deposits in the Mountains using an Iron pickaxe or better. It is used in Obsidian arrows, Silver arrows, Frost arrows, Poison arrows, and many Mountain-tier crafts.

name: Onion
game_description: A crunchy and spicy taste.
description: Onions are a Mountain-tier crop grown from Onion seeds on cultivated ground. The seeds themselves are found in Mountain ruins. Onions are used in Onion soup and many Mountain/Plains-tier recipes.

name: Onion seeds
game_description: Plant to grow a healthy onion.
description: Onion seeds are found inside chests in Mountain ruins. They can be planted with the Cultivator on cultivated ground to grow Onions.

name: Onion soup
game_description: Deliciously rich.
description: Onion soup is a Mountain-tier Stamina food cooked at a Cauldron from Onions. It is a deliciously rich soup that restores generous stamina for cold-biome expeditions.

name: Ooze
game_description: Rotten and putrid-smelling. Why do you want this?
description: Ooze is dropped by Blobs and Oozers in the Swamp. It is the key material for Ooze bombs, Poison arrows, Root armor, and the Stagbreaker.

name: Pine cone
game_description: Plant it to grow a pine tree.
description: Pine cones are tree seeds gathered by chopping Pine trees in the Black Forest. They can be planted with the Cultivator to grow new Pine trees, which yield Wood, Resin, and more Pine cones when felled.

name: Bukeperries
game_description: Allows the consumer to quickly evacuate any misplaced meal and start anew.
description: Bukeperries are a special Black Forest berry that, when eaten, immediately removes all current food buffs so the player can re-eat fresh food. They are found by exploring Sunken Crypts and similar dungeons.

name: Queen bee
game_description: The queen of the bees!
description: A Queen bee is a rare drop from destroying abandoned beehives found in ruined buildings in the Meadows. One Queen bee is required to craft a player-placed Beehive for Honey production.

name: Queens jam
game_description: That classic tasty blend of raspberries and blueberries.
description: Queen's jam is a Black Forest-tier balanced food cooked at a Cauldron from Raspberries and Blueberries. It is a Mountain-friendly travel food.

name: Raspberry
game_description: Sweet and delicious.
description: Raspberries are gathered from glowing Raspberry bushes in the Meadows. They are a basic stamina food eaten raw and used in many recipes including Minor healing mead, Minor stamina mead, Queen's jam, and Boar jerky.

name: Boar meat
game_description: A raw piece of meat, cook it for a tasty treat.
description: Boar meat is the raw meat dropped by Boars in the Meadows. Cook it on a Cooking station to produce Cooked boar meat, the earliest cooked food in the game.

name: Resin
game_description: Sticky tree resin which insulates well. If put to the flame it burns slow and steady.
description: Resin is a sticky tree material gathered from Greydwarves and from chopping Fir trees. It is used to craft Torches, Fire arrows, and as fuel for Standing torches.

name: Core wood
game_description: Perfect for building log cabins.
description: Core wood is a strong, straight log produced by chopping Fir or Pine trees. It is required for the Workbench upgrades, Karve longship, Stagbreaker, and many Bronze-tier crafting stations.

name: Root
game_description: An old root from an ancient tree stump. It feels both flexible and durable at the same time.
description: Root is a flexible material harvested from Ancient tree stumps in the Swamp. It is the key material for the Root armor set and is also used in the Stonecutter.

name: Ruby
game_description: <color=yellow>Valuable</color>
description: Ruby is a Valuable item found inside Sunken Crypt chests and similar treasure piles. It has no crafting use and is sold to Haldor the trader for a substantial number of Coins.

name: Lox saddle
game_description: Use on a lox to be able to ride it.
description: The Lox saddle is a Plains-era item crafted at a Workbench from Leather scraps, Linen thread, and Black metal. When used on a tamed Lox, it allows the player to ride the Lox like a mount.

name: Sap
game_description: Sacred blood from the Great Tree.
description: Sap is a Mistlands material gathered by chopping Yggdrasil shoots. It is combined with Soft tissue at the Eitr refinery to produce Eitr.

name: Sausages
game_description: Links of savory, smoked meat.
description: Sausages are a Swamp-tier Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Entrails, Raw meat, and Thistle. They are one of the early stronger Health foods.

name: Scale hide
game_description: A pelt of glittering scales.
description: Scale hide is a Mistlands material dropped by Asksvin in the Ashlands and Hares in the Mistlands. It is used in the Feather cape, Hare-related recipes, and some Mistlands armor.

name: Serpent scale
game_description: The shiny metal-like scale from a sea serpent.
description: A Serpent scale is dropped by Serpents when harpooned and killed in the Ocean. It is the key material for the Serpent scale shield.

name: Serpent meat
game_description: A slice of sea serpent. Smells fishy.
description: Serpent meat is dropped by killing a Serpent in the Ocean. Cook it on a Cooking station to produce Cooked serpent meat or use it in Serpent stew, one of the strongest Swamp-tier Health foods.

name: Cooked serpent meat
game_description: A cooked slice of sea serpent. Smells good.
description: Cooked serpent meat is the cooked form of Serpent meat, prepared on a Cooking station. It is one of the strongest Swamp/Mountain-era Health foods.

name: Serpent stew
game_description: Smells of honey and serpent...
description: Serpent stew is a Swamp/Mountain-era Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Serpent meat, Mushrooms, and Honey. It provides massive health and stamina for late-Swamp and Mountain expeditions.

name: Muckshake
game_description: Wakes you up!
description: Muckshake is a Swamp-tier Stamina food cooked at a Cauldron from Turnips and Bloodbags. It restores significant stamina for swampy adventures.

name: Sharpening stone
game_description: A whetstone wheel ready to spin.
description: Sharpening stone is a Black Forest workbench upgrade material listed in Item drop. It is paired with the Tanning rack and Adze to increase Workbench crafting level.

name: Silver
game_description: A bar of pure silver ready to be worked.
description: Silver is a Mountain-tier refined ingot smelted from Silver ore at a Smelter using Coal as fuel. It is the key material for Mountain-tier weapons (Silver sword, Frostner, Draugr Fang), the Wolf armor set, and silver-tier shields.

name: Silver necklace
game_description: <color=yellow>Valuable</color>
description: Silver necklace is a Valuable item found inside chests and treasure piles in Mountain Forsaken structures. It has no crafting use and is sold to Haldor the trader for Coins.

name: Silver ore
game_description: Unrefined silver. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
description: Silver ore is the unrefined form of Silver, mined from Silver veins in the Mountains using an Iron pickaxe or better. Silver veins must be located with the Wishbone accessory. Smelt the ore in a Smelter to produce Silver ingots.

name: Soft tissue
game_description: It still fizzes softly with ancient memories.
description: Soft tissue is a Mistlands material mined from Ancient skulls inside Giant remains using a Black metal pickaxe, plus dropped from Dvergr crates and Dvergr enemies. It is combined with Sap at the Eitr refinery to produce Refined eitr.

name: Stone
game_description: It's a rock.
description: Stone is a fundamental building material mined from rocks, boulders, and stone deposits with any pickaxe. It is required for nearly every crafting station, the Stonecutter, the Workbench, and stone construction.

name: Surtling core
game_description: It throbs with inner heat.
description: A Surtling core is a glowing red stone found on stands inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest and dropped by Surtlings. It is required to build the Smelter, Charcoal kiln, Blast furnace, and Portal.

name: Tar
game_description: A sticky lump of tar.
description: Tar is a sticky black material harvested from Tar pits in the Plains by killing Growths and looting their puddles. It is the key material for the Black marble building set and many Plains-tier decoration pieces.

name: Thistle
