game_description: Beautiful but prickly.
description: Thistle is a glowing white flower picked at night in the Black Forest and Swamp. It is used in Sausages, Mountain-tier meads (Frost resistance, Poison resistance), and several alchemy recipes.

name: Thunder stone
game_description: It is crackling with energy.
description: Thunder stone is a Mountain-tier material dropped by Drakes and found in Mountain ruins. It is the key material for the Obliterator and several Mountain-tier portal upgrades.

name: Tin
game_description: A bar of pure tin ready to be worked.
description: Tin is a Black Forest-tier refined ingot smelted from Tin ore at a Smelter using Coal as fuel. It is alloyed with Copper to produce Bronze and used in the Cauldron and Tankard recipes.

name: Tin ore
game_description: Unrefined tin. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
description: Tin ore is the unrefined form of Tin, mined from Tin deposits along Black Forest shorelines with an Antler pickaxe or better. Smelt it in a Smelter to produce Tin ingots.

name: Troll hide
game_description: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill.
description: Troll hide is a thick hide dropped by Forest Trolls in the Black Forest. It is the key material for the Troll armor set, which grants a +15 Sneak skill bonus when worn together.

name: Turnip
game_description: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition.
description: Turnips are a Swamp-tier crop grown from Turnip seeds on cultivated ground. The seeds are gathered from wild Turnip plants in the Swamp. Turnips are used in Turnip stew and Muckshake.

name: Turnip seeds
game_description: These can be planted in cultivated soil.
description: Turnip seeds are gathered from wild Turnip plants found in the Swamp. They can be planted with the Cultivator on cultivated ground to grow Turnips.

name: Turnip stew
game_description: Nutritious and restorative.
description: Turnip stew is a Swamp-tier balanced food cooked at a Cauldron from Turnips and Raw meat. It is one of the longer-duration foods for Swamp expeditions.

name: Withered bone
game_description: A giant bone, knotted like old wood.
description: Withered bones are dropped by Draugrs in the Swamp and found inside Sunken Crypts. Ten Withered bones are required to summon Bonemass, the third boss, on his Forsaken Altar.

name: Wolf fang
game_description: Still sharp.
description: Wolf fangs are dropped by Wolves and Fenrings in the Mountains. They are used to craft the Fang spear, Wolf armor set, and several Mountain-tier weapons.

name: Wolf jerky
game_description: Chewy and full of flavor.
description: Wolf jerky is a Mountain-tier balanced food cooked at a Cauldron from Cooked wolf meat and Honey. It is shelf-stable and provides a long-lasting health and stamina buff for cold-biome travel.

name: Wolf meat
description: Wolf meat is the raw meat dropped by Wolves in the Mountains. Cook it on a Cooking station to produce Cooked wolf meat, a Mountain-tier Health food.

name: Wolf skewer
game_description: Dripping with taste.
description: Wolf skewer is a Mountain-tier Health food cooked at a Cauldron from Cooked wolf meat, Mushrooms, and Onions. It provides strong health for cold-biome adventures.

name: Wolf pelt
game_description: A pelt of shaggy fur.
description: A Wolf pelt is dropped by Wolves in the Mountains. It is used to craft the Wolf armor set, Wolf fur cape, and the Drake helmet — all of which grant frost resistance.

name: Wood
game_description: Good, strong wood to build with.
description: Wood is the fundamental building material in Valheim, harvested by chopping any tree with an axe. It is required for nearly every early structure, the Workbench, and countless recipes.

name: Torn spirit
game_description: The remains of Yagluth, a twisted spirit torn between this world and the next.
description: Torn spirit is a unique drop from defeating Yagluth, the fifth boss. It is currently mostly trophy-like — collected as proof of victory and tied to Yagluth's Forsaken power claim at the altar.

name: Yggdrasil wood
game_description: Godflesh, wood from the Great Tree.
description: Yggdrasil wood is a Mistlands material gathered by chopping Yggdrasil shoots with a Black metal axe or better. It is used in the Mistlands-tier Yggdrasil pieces and several magic-tier crafts.

name: Ymir flesh
game_description: The earthy remains of the giant Ymir.
description: Ymir flesh is a Mountain-tier material sold by Haldor the trader for Coins. It is required to craft the Iron sledge, Frostner, the Silver sword, and several other Mountain-tier weapons.

name: Armor stand
description: An Armor stand is a placeable display piece used to display the player's full armor set on a humanoid mannequin. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Bronze nails, and Leather scraps.

name: Female variant of the armor stand
description: An Armor stand (female variant) is a placeable display piece used to display armor on a female-styled mannequin. It functions identically to the standard Armor stand.

name: Male variant of the armor stand
description: An Armor stand (male variant) is a placeable display piece used to display armor on a male-styled mannequin. It functions identically to the standard Armor stand.

name: Greydwarf nest roots
game_description:
The Greydwarf nest is a creature spawner located in the Black Forest. 

This nest can produce any type of Greydwarf. The enemies that are spawned have a 15% probability of being 1 star and a 2.25% chance of being 2 stars.

The nest starts spawning when a player is within 60 meters. It tries to generate within 4 meters every 12 seconds until there are 3 Greydwarves within a 20-meter radius.
description: Greydwarf nest roots are the writhing roots that protrude from a Greydwarf Nest spawner. Destroying the nest will yield Ancient seeds and stop Greydwarves from spawning at that location.

name: Fuling Club
description: A Fuling Club is an item dropped by Fulings in the Plains. It is the simple wooden cudgel they wield in melee, and can be equipped by the player as a weak Plains-tier blunt weapon.

name: Fuling Helmet
description: A Fuling Helmet is a cosmetic helmet dropped occasionally by Fulings in the Plains. It can be worn by the player as a fun cosmetic piece — its armor value is minimal.

name: Fuling Legband
description: A Fuling Legband is a cosmetic armor piece dropped by Fulings in the Plains. It is purely decorative and provides minimal protection.

name: Fuling Loin
description: A Fuling Loin is a cosmetic loincloth piece dropped by Fulings in the Plains. It is purely decorative and provides minimal protection.

name: Fuling Shoulders
description: Fuling Shoulders are a cosmetic shoulder armor piece dropped by Fulings in the Plains. They are purely decorative and provide minimal protection.

name: Fuling Spear
description: A Fuling Spear is dropped by Spear Fulings in the Plains. It can be equipped by the player as a thrown Plains-tier spear weapon.

name: Fuling Sword
description: A Fuling Sword is dropped by Fulings in the Plains. It can be equipped by the player as a Plains-tier slash weapon.

name: Fuling Torch
description: A Fuling Torch is dropped by certain Fuling variants in the Plains. It can be equipped by the player as a torch that deals blunt and fire damage.

name: Fuling totem
game_description: Channels the ancient power of Yagluth.
description: A Fuling totem is a unique drop from Fuling shamans. Five Fuling totems are required to summon Yagluth, the fifth boss, on his Forsaken Altar in the Plains.

name: Valkyrie
description: A Valkyrie is the winged spirit that carries new Vikings into Valheim at the start of the game. She appears briefly during the introductory cutscene and is not encountered during normal gameplay.

name: Evil bone pile
description: An Evil bone pile is an enemy spawner found in the Swamp and similar dungeons. Destroying it stops further enemy spawns at that location.

name: Blob spawnpoint
description: A Blob spawnpoint is an internal Swamp enemy spawner that periodically generates Blobs nearby. It is not a player-placed item and is spawned only via the console or as part of world generation.

name: Oozer spawnpoint
description: An Oozer spawnpoint is an internal Swamp enemy spawner that periodically generates Oozers. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Growth spawnpoint
description: A Growth spawnpoint is an internal Plains enemy spawner that periodically generates Growths near Tar pits. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Growth spawnpoint (1 hour timer)
description: A Growth spawnpoint with a 1-hour respawn timer. It is an internal Plains enemy spawner variant.

name: Boar spawnpoint
description: A Boar spawnpoint is an internal Meadows spawner that periodically generates Boars. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Draugr spawnpoint
description: A Draugr spawnpoint is an internal Swamp enemy spawner that periodically generates Draugrs. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Body pile
description: A Body pile is an internal corpse-themed Draugr spawner found inside Sunken Crypts. Destroying it stops further Draugr spawns at that location.

name: Draugr elite spawnpoint
description: A Draugr elite spawnpoint is an internal Swamp enemy spawner that periodically generates Draugr Elites. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Draugr spawnpoint (noise triggered)
description: A noise-triggered Draugr spawnpoint that generates Draugrs only when nearby sound triggers it. It is an internal Swamp spawner variant.

name: Draugr archer spawnpoint
description: A Draugr archer spawnpoint is an internal Swamp enemy spawner that periodically generates Draugr Archers. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Draugr archer spawnpoint (noise triggered)
description: A noise-triggered Draugr archer spawnpoint that generates Draugr Archers only when nearby sound triggers it. It is an internal Swamp spawner variant.

name: Draugr spawnpoint (30 minute timer)
description: A Draugr spawnpoint with a 30-minute respawn timer. It is an internal Swamp enemy spawner variant.

name: Fenring spawnpoint
description: A Fenring spawnpoint is an internal Mountain enemy spawner that periodically generates Fenrings. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Fish (tuna) spawnpoint
description: A Tuna spawnpoint is an internal Ocean fish spawner that periodically generates Tuna. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Ghost spawnpoint
description: A Ghost spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Ghosts at night. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Random fuling spawnpoint (club, sword, torch)
description: A Random Fuling spawnpoint is an internal Plains spawner that generates a random Fuling variant (club, sword, or torch). It is not a player-placed item.

name: Fuling spearman spawnpoint
description: A Fuling spearman spawnpoint is an internal Plains spawner that periodically generates Spear Fulings. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Fuling Berserker spawnpoint
description: A Fuling Berserker spawnpoint is an internal Plains spawner that generates Fuling berserkers, typically inside Fuling villages. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Fuling shaman spawnpoint
description: A Fuling shaman spawnpoint is an internal Plains spawner that generates Fuling shamans, typically inside Fuling villages. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf spawnpoint
description: A Greydwarf spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Greydwarves. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf nest
description: A Greydwarf nest is a destructible spawner found in the Black Forest that periodically generates Greydwarves. Destroying the nest stops further spawns and may yield Ancient seeds.

name: Greydwarf brute spawnpoint
description: A Greydwarf Brute spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Greydwarf Brutes. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf Shaman spawnpoint
description: A Greydwarf Shaman spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Greydwarf Shamans. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Drake spawnpoint
description: A Drake spawnpoint is an internal Mountain spawner that periodically generates Drakes. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Leech (cave variant) spawnpoint
description: A Leech (cave variant) spawnpoint is an internal Mountain Frost Cave spawner that periodically generates Leeches. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf brute spawnpoint
description: A location-specific Greydwarf Brute spawnpoint used in pre-built Black Forest structures. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf spawnpoint
description: A location-specific Greydwarf spawnpoint used in pre-built Black Forest structures. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Greydwarf shaman spawnpoint
description: A location-specific Greydwarf Shaman spawnpoint used in pre-built Black Forest structures. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Skeleton spawnpoint
description: A Skeleton spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Skeletons. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Skeleton spawnpoint (melee and night only)
description: A nighttime melee-only Skeleton spawnpoint that generates Melee Skeletons only at night. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Rancid remains spawnpoint
description: A Rancid Remains spawnpoint is an internal Swamp spawner that periodically generates Rancid Remains, the poisonous Skeleton variant. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Skeleton spawnpoint (1 hour timer)
description: A Skeleton spawnpoint with a 1-hour respawn timer. It is an internal Black Forest spawner variant.

name: Stone golem spawnpoint
description: A Stone Golem spawnpoint is an internal Mountain spawner that periodically generates Stone Golems. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Troll spawnpoint
description: A Troll spawnpoint is an internal Black Forest spawner that periodically generates Trolls. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Wraith spawnpoint
description: A Wraith spawnpoint is an internal Swamp spawner that periodically generates Wraiths at night. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Surtling spawnpoint
description: A Surtling spawnpoint is an internal Swamp/Ashlands spawner that periodically generates Surtlings near Fire Geysers and lava. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Surtling spawnpoint (5 minute timer)
description: A Surtling spawnpoint with a 5-minute respawn timer. It is an internal Swamp/Ashlands spawner variant.

name: Cart
description:
Carts are designed to store and convey items across distances, driven by human strength. Players can "attach" and "detach" themselves from the cart using the interact key, facilitating its pull. The cumulative weight of items inside and the terrain's gradient influence the ease or difficulty of pulling. Adhering to physics, the cart can roll downhill if released on a slope and can even be tugged while swimming.

Carts can't be dismantled for resources using the hammer; they can only be damaged until destroyed.

name: Raft
description: The Raft is Valheim's starting water vehicle, crafted at a Workbench from Wood, Leather scraps, and Resin. It is slow and only practical for short crossings, but unlocks Ocean travel before Iron-tier ships are available.

name: Karve
description: The Karve is a small Bronze-tier longship crafted at a Workbench from Fine wood, Deer hide, Resin, and Bronze nails. It is faster and tougher than the Raft and includes a small storage compartment, suitable for medium-distance trips.

name: Longship
description: The Longship is a large Iron-tier vessel crafted at a Workbench from Fine wood, Ancient bark, Iron nails, and Deer hide. It is the standard ocean-going ship and includes a sizeable cargo hold for hauling ore and resources.

name: Trailership
description: The Trailership is an Ashlands-update cargo vessel designed for long-distance hauling. It offers more storage space than the Longship and is suited for ferrying large loads of late-game resources.

name: Beech tree
description: Beech trees are the small, leafy hardwood trees that dot the Meadows. Each tree drops Wood when felled with any axe and is one of the first wood sources Vikings have access to.

name: Beech sapling
description: A Beech sapling is the young growing form of a Beech tree, planted by using a Cultivator and Beech seeds on cultivated ground. It grows into a fully harvestable Beech tree over time.

name: Beech stump
description: A Beech stump is what remains after a Beech tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Wood and clear the ground for building.

name: Small beech tree type 1
description: A small Beech tree is a juvenile sapling of the Beech tree, found across the Meadows. It can be felled with any axe to gather a small amount of Wood.

name: Small beech tree type 2
description: A small Beech tree is a juvenile sapling of the Beech tree, found across the Meadows. It can be felled with any axe to gather a small amount of Wood.

name: Beehive
description: The Beehive is a placeable apiary that produces Honey over time when set up outdoors with at least one clear cell of space around it. It is built from Wood and a Queen bee dropped from beehives in abandoned buildings in the Meadows.

name: Birch tree type 1
description: Birch trees are tall, slender hardwood trees found in the Meadows that drop Fine wood when felled. A Bronze axe or better is required to chop them down, gating Fine wood behind Black Forest progression.

name: Birch tree type 2
description: Birch trees are tall, slender hardwood trees found in the Meadows that drop Fine wood when felled. A Bronze axe or better is required to chop them down, gating Fine wood behind Black Forest progression.

name: Birch stump
description: A Birch stump is what remains after a Birch tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Fine wood.

name: Downed birch tree
description: A downed Birch tree is the trunk that remains after felling a Birch tree. It can be chopped with a Bronze axe or better to yield additional Fine wood.

name: Half of a downed birch tree
description: Half of a downed Birch tree is the smaller log section that remains after partially chopping a fallen Birch trunk. It can be chopped further to yield additional Fine wood.

name: Blueberry Bush
game_description: Tiny but tasty.
description: Blueberry bushes are pickable plants found throughout the Black Forest that yield Blueberries when interacted with. They respawn over time, providing a reliable Stamina food source for the early game.

name: Ooze bomb
game_description: The stench is unbearable...
description: The Ooze bomb is a Swamp-era throwable explosive crafted from Ooze, Bone fragments, and Leather scraps at the Cauldron. On impact, it spreads a cloud of poison gas that deals area-of-effect poison damage to enemies caught inside.

name: Sacrificial Stone (Bonemass)
description: Bonemass's Sacrificial Stone is the Forsaken Altar in the Swamp where Bonemass is summoned. Placing ten Withered bones on the stone summons the third boss; after the kill, the Bonemass trophy can be hung here to claim his Forsaken power.

name: Sacrificial Stone (Moder)
description: Moder's Sacrificial Stone is the Forsaken Altar atop a Mountain where Moder is summoned. Placing three Dragon eggs on the stone summons the fourth boss; after the kill, the Moder trophy can be hung here to claim her Forsaken power.

name: Sacrificial Stone (Eikthyr)
description: Eikthyr's Sacrificial Stone is the Forsaken Altar in the Meadows where Eikthyr is summoned. Placing two Deer trophies on the stone summons the first boss; after the kill, the Eikthyr trophy can be hung here to claim his Forsaken power.

name: Sacrificial Stone (The Elder)
description: The Elder's Sacrificial Stone is the Forsaken Altar in the Black Forest where The Elder is summoned. Placing three Ancient seeds on the stone summons the second boss; after the kill, The Elder trophy can be hung here to claim his Forsaken power.

name: Sacrificial Stone (Yagluth)
description: Yagluth's Sacrificial Stone is the Forsaken Altar in the Plains where Yagluth is summoned. Placing five Fuling totems on the stone summons the fifth boss; after the kill, the Yagluth trophy can be hung here to claim his Forsaken power.

name: Bush 1 color 1
description: A common decorative bush variant found across the Meadows and Black Forest. It can be cleared with a Cultivator and yields no resources on its own.

name: Bush 1 color 2
description: A decorative bush variant found in the Plains and Meadows. It can be cleared with a Cultivator and yields no resources on its own.

name: Bush 2
description: A larger decorative bush variant found across several biomes. It can be cleared with a Cultivator and yields no resources on its own.

name: 1x1 wooden cube
description: A 1x1 wooden cube is a decorative wooden crate found inside ruined buildings and Stone tower locations. It is not player-craftable but can be destroyed for a small amount of Wood.

name: Standing iron torch (no loot)
description: A Standing iron torch (no loot) is a non-craftable variant of the iron torch found in pre-built world locations like ruins and dungeons. It functions like a normal standing torch but cannot be picked up.

name: Standing green-burning iron torch (no loot)
description: A Standing green-burning iron torch (no loot) is a non-craftable green-flame torch variant found in pre-built world locations. It functions normally but cannot be picked up.

name: Standing wood torch (no loot)
description: A Standing wood torch (no loot) is a non-craftable unlit wood torch variant found in pre-built world locations. It can be lit but cannot be picked up.

name: Small pot (no collision, falls forever)
description: A small pot (no collision) is a decorative pottery object found inside ruined buildings. Due to a quirk, it has no collision and will fall through floors if disturbed.

name: Chain
game_description: A link of iron chain.
description: Chain is a Material dropped by Wraiths in the Swamp and occasionally found inside Sunken Crypts. It is used as a crafting ingredient for late-game items and structures, including the Iron sledge and the Stonecutter.

name: Chest
description: A standard wooden Chest is a placeable storage container that holds 10 stacks of items. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Fine wood.

name: Cloudberry Bush
game_description: The gold of the forest.
description: A Cloudberry bush is a Plains-biome pickable plant that yields Cloudberries when interacted with. The bushes regrow over time, providing a renewable Plains-tier stamina food source.

name: Explosion inflicts burning, freezing, poison
description: Eikthyr's death explosion is the visual and damage effect when Eikthyr dies, inflicting burning, freezing, and poison status effects briefly. It is an internal combat effect, not a player item.

name: Draugr elite corpse
description: Draugr Elite corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Draugr Elite is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Draugr corpse
description: Draugr corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Draugr is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Draugr archer corpse
description: Draugr Archer corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Draugr Archer is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Greydwarf nest type 2
description: A Greydwarf nest (type 2) is a variant of the destructible Greydwarf nest found in the Black Forest. Destroying it stops further Greydwarf spawns at that location.

name: Non-functional spawner object
description: A non-functional spawner object is the internal Swamp dungeon spawner prefab. It governs creature respawns inside Sunken Crypts and is not meant to be interacted with directly.

name: Fenring corpse
description: Fenring corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Fenring is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Fir tree
description: Fir trees are the tall coniferous trees that dominate the Black Forest. They drop both Wood and the occasional Resin and Pine cone, and are typically felled with a Stone or Flint axe.

name: Fir tree sapling
description: A Fir tree sapling is the young growing form of a Fir tree, planted by using a Cultivator and Fir cones on cultivated ground. It grows into a fully harvestable Fir tree over time.

name: Fir tree stump
description: A Fir tree stump is what remains after a Fir tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Wood.

name: Downed fir tree
description: A downed Fir tree is the trunk that remains after felling a Fir tree. It can be chopped with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Half of a downed fir tree
description: Half of a downed Fir tree is the smaller log section that remains after partially chopping a fallen Fir trunk. It can be chopped further with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Moss covered log
description: A moss-covered log is a decaying fallen Fir tree found in the Black Forest. It can be chopped with an axe to yield Wood.

name: Small fir tree
description: A small Fir tree is a juvenile Fir sapling that drops a few units of Wood when chopped with any axe.

name: Small fir tree type 2
description: A dead small Fir tree is a withered juvenile Fir found in the Black Forest. It can be chopped with any axe to yield a small amount of Wood.

name: Blue fire fly visual effect
description: Blue fireflies are a small visual particle effect found in the Mistlands at night. They are purely atmospheric and not interactable.

name: Fishing bobber
description: A fishing bobber is the floating indicator on the water when a Fishing rod is cast. It is part of the fishing mechanic and not a player item.

name: Visual and sound effects of fishing line cast
description: A fishing line cast projectile is the visual and sound effect when a Fishing rod is cast. It is part of the fishing mechanic and not a player item.

name: Tiny white partical cloud
description: Flies are a tiny white particle cloud visual effect that appears near corpses and rotting environments. They are purely atmospheric.

name: Forest troll corpse
description: Forest troll corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Forest troll is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Glowing mushroom (unremovable)
description: A Glowing mushroom is a decorative bioluminescent mushroom found inside Burial Chambers and similar Black Forest dungeons. It cannot be picked or moved — purely environmental lighting.

name: Fuling Armband
description: FulingArmband is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling enemies in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means and exists only as part of the enemy's appearance.

name: Fuling Brute Arm Guard
description: FulingBrute ArmGuard is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Brute sword (non-functional)
description: Brute sword (non-functional) is the internal weapon used by Fuling berserkers in their primary attack. It is non-functional for the player and exists only as part of the enemy's combat behavior.

name: Fuling Brute Backbones
description: FulingBrute Backbones is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Fuling Brute Executioner Cap
description: FulingBrute ExecutionerCap is the internal hooded helmet worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Fuling Brute Hip Cloth
description: FulingBrute HipCloth is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Fuling Brute Leg Bones
description: FulingBrute LegBones is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Brute sword (non-functional)
description: Brute sword (non-functional) is the internal weapon used by Fuling berserkers in their rage attack. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Fuling Brute Shoulder Guard
description: FulingBrute ShoulderGuard is an internal armor piece worn by Fuling berserkers in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Brute sword (non-functional)
description: Brute sword (non-functional) is the internal weapon used by Fuling berserkers in their taunt animation. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Fuling Berserker corpse
description: Fuling Berserker corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Fuling berserker is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Yagluth corpse
description: Yagluth corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when Yagluth is defeated. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling shaman headdress antlers
description: Fuling shaman headdress antlers is an internal cosmetic piece worn by Fuling shamans in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Fuling shaman headdress feathers
description: Fuling shaman headdress feathers is an internal cosmetic piece worn by Fuling shamans in the Plains. It is not obtainable by the player through normal means.

name: Fuling shaman staff bones
description: Fuling shaman staff bones is the internal weapon variant carried by Fuling shamans in the Plains. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Fuling shaman staff feathers
description: Fuling shaman staff feathers is the internal weapon variant carried by Fuling shamans in the Plains. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Fuling shaman attack poke
description: Fuling shaman attack poke is the internal melee attack effect used by Fuling shamans. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling shaman projectile fireball
description: Fuling shaman projectile fireball is the internal fireball attack used by Fuling shamans. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling shaman protect area of effect
description: Fuling shaman protect AoE is the internal protective heal effect used by Fuling shamans on nearby allies. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling shaman corpse
description: Fuling shaman corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Fuling shaman is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling spear projectile
description: Fuling spear projectile is the internal thrown-spear attack used by Spear Fulings. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling corpse
description: Fuling corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Fuling is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Greydwarf shaman corpse
description: Greydwarf shaman corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Greydwarf shaman is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Greydwarf brute corpse
description: Greydwarf Brute corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Greydwarf Brute is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Greydwarf corpse
description: Greydwarf corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Greydwarf is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Greydwarf throw projectile
description: Greydwarf throw projectile is the internal stick-throwing attack used by Greydwarves at range. It is not a player item.

name: Greyling corpse
description: Greyling corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Greyling is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Gucksack
description: A Gucksack is a glowing fungal growth that protrudes from Ancient trees in the Swamp. It can be destroyed to yield Guck, used in late-game Mountain-tier weapons like the Draugr Fang bow.

name: Small Gucksack
description: A Small Gucksack is a smaller variant of the Gucksack fungal growth attached to Ancient trees in the Swamp. It yields Guck when destroyed.

name: Drake corpse
description: Drake corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Drake is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Bonemass Heart
description: Bonemass Heart is the unique Forsaken trophy power that grants Bonemass's resistance buff to the player. It is claimed by hanging the Bonemass trophy at the Sacrificial Stone in the Swamp.

name: Elder Heart
description: Elder Heart is the unique Forsaken trophy power that grants The Elder's chopping/regen buff to the player. It is claimed by hanging The Elder trophy at the Sacrificial Stone in the Black Forest.

name: Large stone pillar
description: Large stone pillars are tall standing-stone formations found across the Plains. They can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Large swamp root
description: A Large swamp root is a thick root that protrudes from the muddy ground in the Swamp biome. It is a piece of environmental decoration and is destructible with an axe.

name: Moder's thrown ice chunks
description: Moder's thrown ice chunks are the projectiles created when Moder uses her cold-breath shotgun attack. They deal frost damage on impact and are not items the player carries.

name: Surtling fireball projectile
description: Surtling fireball projectile is the internal fireball attack used by Surtlings. It is not a player item.

name: Copper vein type 2
description: Copper vein is an internal resource node prefab not naturally found in normal gameplay. It can only be spawned via the console; the standard Black Forest Copper source is the Copper deposit boulder.

name: Iron vein
description: Iron vein is removed content that no longer appears naturally in the game. It can only be spawned via the console with this internal ID, and historically required a Bronze pickaxe to mine for Iron ore.

name: Flametal vein
description: Flametal vein is the internal meteorite-style mining prefab historically tied to Flametal ore. Following the Ashlands update, Flametal ore is sourced from dedicated Flametal ore veins requiring a Black metal pickaxe, and this prefab may only appear via the console.

name: Obsidian deposit
description: An Obsidian deposit is a sharp black rock formation found in the Mountains. It can be mined with an Iron pickaxe or better to yield Obsidian.

name: Minable rock pile
description: A minable rock pile is a small destructible boulder found across most biomes. It can be mined with any pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Tin deposit
description: A Tin deposit is a small silvery rock formation found along shorelines in the Black Forest. It can be mined with an Antler pickaxe or better to yield Tin ore.

name: Headstone shaped rock
description: A headstone-shaped rock is a decorative grave-marker boulder found in the Mountains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Neck corpse
description: Neck corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Neck is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Old thatch roof 26°
description: The Old thatch roof 26° is the legacy thatch roof piece pre-dating the current building system. It is functionally identical to the current Thatch roof piece and remains buildable for compatibility with old saves.

name: Old thatch roof 26° icorner
description: The Old thatch roof 26° i-corner is the legacy inside-corner variant of the thatch roof. It functions identically to the current i-corner roof piece and remains buildable for compatibility with old saves.

name: Old thatch roof 26° ocorner
description: The Old thatch roof 26° o-corner is the legacy outside-corner variant of the thatch roof. It functions identically to the current o-corner roof piece and remains buildable for compatibility with old saves.

name: Old thatch roof 26° ridge
description: The Old thatch roof 26° ridge is the legacy ridge cap variant of the thatch roof. It functions identically to the current roof ridge piece and remains buildable for compatibility with old saves.

name: Old wood wall 26°
description: The Old wood wall 26° is the legacy angled wall piece that pairs with old thatch roofs. It remains buildable for compatibility with old saves.

name: Oak 1
description: Oak trees are massive hardwood trees found in the Meadows that drop large amounts of Fine wood when felled. They require a Bronze axe or better to chop down, and a single Oak can yield many stacks of Fine wood.

name: Oak stump
description: An Oak stump is what remains after an Oak tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Fine wood.

name: Oak log
description: An Oak log is the trunk that remains after felling an Oak tree. It can be chopped with a Bronze axe or better to yield additional Fine wood.

name: Oak log half
description: Half of an Oak log is the smaller section that remains after partially chopping a fallen Oak trunk. It can be chopped further with a Bronze axe or better to yield additional Fine wood.

name: Pickable barley
game_description: A bundle of barley.
description: Pickable barley is a cultivated barley plant ready to harvest. Each plant yields Barley when picked, used at the Windmill to produce Barley flour for Bread and pies.

name: Pickable barley
game_description: A bundle of barley.
description: Wild pickable barley is the rare wild form of barley found growing naturally in the Plains. Each plant yields a few Barley seeds when picked.

name: Pickable bog iron
description: Pickable bog iron is a small Iron-bearing object dropped by the Bog Witch in newer Valheim updates. It can be picked up directly without mining.

name: Pickable branch spawner
description: Pickable branches are small wood pickups scattered across the Meadows and Black Forest. Each pickup yields a small amount of Wood without requiring an axe.

name: Pickable Carrot
description: Pickable carrots are cultivated carrot plants ready to harvest. Each yields one Carrot when picked, used in soups, stews, and as a Stamina food.

name: Pickable dandelion spawner
description: Pickable dandelions are flowers found in the Meadows. Each yields one Dandelion when picked, used in food recipes like Queen's jam and Minor healing mead.

name: Random pickable Valuables
description: A pickable Dolmen treasure pile is a random treasure object found at burial dolmens in the Meadows. It yields valuable loot like Amber, Coins, or Rubies.

name: Pickable Dragon egg spawner
description: A pickable Dragon egg is a glowing purple egg found in Drake nests in the Mountains. Three Dragon eggs are needed to summon Moder, and each egg weighs 200 — only one can be carried at a time.

name: Pickable flax
description: Pickable flax is a cultivated flax plant ready to harvest. Each yields Flax when picked, used at the Spinning wheel to produce Linen thread.

name: Pickable flax
description: Wild pickable flax is the rare wild form of flax found growing naturally in the Plains. Each plant yields a few Flax seeds when picked.

name: Pickable Flint spawner
description: Pickable Flint is a small chunk of flint scattered along shorelines and beaches. Each yields one Flint when picked, used in early-game weapons and tools.

name: Random pickable Valuables
description: A pickable random Valuables stack found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. It yields random loot like Amber, Coins, or trinkets.

name: Skeletal remains type 1
description: Skeletal remains found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. Each pile yields Bone fragments when interacted with.

name: Skeletal remains type 2
description: Skeletal remains found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. Each pile yields Bone fragments when interacted with.

name: Skeletal remains type 3
description: Skeletal remains found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. Each pile yields Bone fragments when interacted with.

name: Skeletal remains type 4
description: Skeletal remains found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. Each pile yields Bone fragments when interacted with.

name: Pickable iron meteorite
description: A pickable iron meteorite is a small fallen meteor object that yields a small amount of Iron when picked up.

name: Skeletal remains type 5
description: Buried skeletal remains found in the Mountains, often near abandoned ruins. They yield Bone fragments when interacted with.

name: Mushroom spawnpoint
description: A Mushroom spawn point yields a Mushroom when picked. Mushrooms are common in the Meadows and Black Forest and respawn over time.

name: Blue mushroom spawnpoint
description: A Blue mushroom spawn point yields a Blue mushroom when picked. Blue mushrooms are typically found inside Burial Chambers and similar dungeons in the Black Forest.

name: Yellow mushroom spawnpoint
description: A Yellow mushroom spawn point yields a Yellow mushroom when picked. Yellow mushrooms are found in the Black Forest and are used in Minor and Medium stamina meads.

name: Pickable Obsidian
description: Pickable Obsidian is a loose Obsidian chunk found near Drake nests and rocky areas in the Mountains. Each yields one Obsidian when picked up.

name: Pickable Onion
description: Pickable onions are cultivated onion plants ready to harvest. Each yields one Onion when picked, used in soups and other Mountain-tier recipes.

name: Pickable random food
description: A random food pickable that yields a random consumable item — usually a berry, mushroom, or similar simple food.

name: Pickable Carrot seeds
description: Pickable Carrot seeds are cultivated carrot seed pods ready to harvest. Each yields Carrot seeds, which can be replanted to grow more carrots.

name: Pickable Onion seeds
description: Pickable Onion seeds are cultivated onion seed pods ready to harvest. Each yields Onion seeds, which can be replanted to grow more onions.

name: Pickable Turnip seeds
description: Pickable Turnip seeds are cultivated turnip seed pods ready to harvest. Each yields Turnip seeds, which can be replanted to grow more turnips.

name: Pickable Stone
description: Pickable Stone is a small chunk of stone scattered across most biomes. Each yields one Stone when picked, useful for early-game building before a pickaxe is crafted.

name: Random pickable Valuables
description: A pickable random Valuables stack found inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. It yields random loot including Iron scrap, Ancient bark, and Withered bones.

name: Pickable Surtling core stand
description: A pickable Surtling core stand is a glowing stone pedestal inside Burial Chambers that yields a Surtling core when interacted with. Surtling cores are required to build Smelters and Charcoal kilns.

name: Pickable Tar
description: Pickable Tar is a small puddle of tar found inside Tar pits in the Plains. Each yields one Tar when picked up.

name: Pickable Tar
description: A large pickable Tar puddle is the bigger Tar pit variant in the Plains. Each yields several units of Tar when picked up.

name: Pickable Thistle
description: Pickable Thistle is a glowing-white flower that grows in the Black Forest and Swamp at night. Each yields one Thistle when picked, used in Frost resistance and Poison resistance meads.

name: Pickable Tin
description: Pickable Tin is a loose Tin chunk found along shorelines in the Black Forest. Each yields a small amount of Tin ore when picked up.

name: Pickable Turnip
description: Pickable turnips are cultivated turnip plants ready to harvest. Each yields one Turnip when picked, used in Turnip stew and Muckshakes.

name: Old Pine tree
description: An old Pine tree is a tall mature pine found in the Black Forest. It drops Wood, Resin, and Pine cones when felled with any axe.

name: Pine tree sapling
description: A Pine tree sapling is the young growing form of a Pine tree, planted by using a Cultivator and Pine cones on cultivated ground. It grows into a fully harvestable Pine tree over time.

name: Downed pine tree
description: A downed Pine tree is the trunk that remains after felling a Pine tree. It can be chopped with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Old downed pine tree
description: An old downed Pine tree is a weathered fallen pine found in the Black Forest. It can be chopped with an axe to yield Wood.

name: Half of a downed pine tree
description: Half of a downed Pine tree is the smaller section that remains after partially chopping a fallen Pine trunk. It can be chopped further with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Half of an old downed pine tree
description: Half of an old downed Pine tree is the smaller weathered section that remains after partially chopping a fallen old Pine trunk. It can be chopped further with an axe to yield Wood.

name: Pine tree
description: A Pine tree is a coniferous tree found in the Black Forest. It drops Wood, Resin, and the occasional Pine cone when felled with any axe.

name: Pine tree stump
description: A Pine tree stump is what remains after a Pine tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Wood.

name: Player corpse
description: Player corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when the player dies. It is not a player item.

name: Tombstone
description: A Tombstone is the placeable marker that appears at the player's death location, holding the player's lost inventory. Interacting with it returns all dropped items to the player.

name: Raspberry Bush
description: Raspberry bushes are pickable plants found throughout the Meadows that yield Raspberries when interacted with. They respawn over time, providing an easy early-game Stamina food source.

name: Giant stone finger from Yagulth's alter
description: A giant stone finger from Yagluth's altar — a decorative stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Broken stone finger from Yagulth's alter
description: A broken stone finger from Yagluth's altar — a decorative damaged stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Broken stone finger from Yagulth's alter
description: A broken stone finger from Yagluth's altar — a decorative damaged stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Giant stone finger from Yagulth's alter
description: A giant stone finger from Yagluth's altar — a decorative stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Giant stone thumb from Yagulth's alter
description: A giant stone thumb from Yagluth's altar — a decorative stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Giant stone thumb from Yagulth's alter
description: A giant stone thumb from Yagluth's altar — a decorative stone formation that surrounds the final boss arena in the Plains.

name: Rock 3
description: A generic environmental rock prefab found across multiple biomes. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Rock 3 damaged
description: The damaged variant of a generic environmental rock that has been partially mined.

name: Rock 4
description: A generic environmental rock prefab found across multiple biomes. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Rock 4 plains
description: A Plains variant of the generic environmental rock prefab. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Rock 7
description: A generic environmental rock prefab found in the wild. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Destructible rock
description: A Destructible rock is a generic minable rock prefab found in the wild. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Minable rock pile
description: An internal developer test rock prefab. It is mineable but otherwise has no normal gameplay function.

name: Small human skull
description: A Small human skull is a decorative skull object found inside burial sites and crypts. It can be destroyed for Bone fragments.

name: Giant human skull
description: A Giant human skull is a large decorative skull object found inside Burial Chambers and dungeons. It can be destroyed for additional Bone fragments compared to its smaller cousin.

name: Stamina Greydwarf
description: The Stamina Greydwarf is an unused or internal stamina-buff prefab tied to Greydwarves. It does not appear in normal gameplay.

name: Stamina Troll
description: The Stamina Troll is an unused or internal stamina-buff prefab tied to Trolls. It does not appear in normal gameplay.

name: Stamina Wraith
description: The Stamina Wraith is an unused or internal stamina-buff prefab tied to Wraiths. It does not appear in normal gameplay.

name: Corgi statue
description: The Corgi statue is a decorative dwarven statue of a corgi dog, sometimes appearing in Dvergr or hidden ruins. It is purely decorative and cannot be crafted.

name: Deer statue
description: The Deer statue is a decorative bronze statue of a deer found near Sacrificial Stones at the world spawn. It commemorates Eikthyr, the first boss.

name: Swamp statue
description: The Swamp statue is a decorative ominous statue found inside Sunken Crypts. It is purely environmental and cannot be crafted or moved.

name: Rabbit statue
description: The Rabbit statue is a decorative statue of a hare. It is purely decorative and cannot be crafted.

name: Ancient seed statue
description: The Ancient seed statue is a decorative statue resembling an Ancient seed. It is purely decorative and cannot be crafted.

name: Stone golem clubs
description: Stone golem clubs is the internal weapon used by Stone Golems in their primary smash attack. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Stone golem hat
description: Stone golem hat is an internal cosmetic piece worn by certain Stone Golem variants in the Mountains. It is not obtainable by the player.

name: Stone golem spikes
description: Stone golem spikes is the internal weapon used by Stone Golems in their spike-volley attack. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Stone golem corpse
description: Stone golem corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Stone Golem is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Ancient tree
description: An Ancient tree is a massive, gnarled tree native to the Swamp. It requires a Bronze axe or better to chop down and yields generous amounts of Ancient bark, used in many Iron and Mountain-tier crafts.

name: Ancient tree stump
description: An Ancient tree stump is what remains after an Ancient tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Ancient bark.

name: Downed ancient tree
description: A downed Ancient tree is the trunk that remains after felling an Ancient tree in the Swamp. It can be chopped with a Bronze axe or better to yield additional Ancient bark.

name: Ancient tree (unbreakable)
description: An Ancient tree (unbreakable) is a non-destructible variant of the Swamp's Ancient trees, used as world decoration. Unlike its harvestable cousin, this variant cannot be chopped down.

name: Mistlands ancient tree (unbreakable)
description: A Mistlands ancient tree (unbreakable) is a non-destructible large tree variant used as Mistlands decoration. It is purely environmental.

name: Downed ancient tree (unbreakable)
description: A downed Ancient tree (unbreakable) is a non-destructible fallen-trunk variant used as Swamp decoration. Unlike harvestable downed trees, this variant cannot be chopped.

name: Liquid
description: Tar liquid is the internal puddle prefab that makes up the surface of Tar pits in the Plains. Walking through it slows the player and applies a tar status effect.

name: Chest (Black forest loot)
description: A Black Forest treasure chest is the loot variant found in Black Forest dungeons, Troll caves, and ruined structures. It contains randomized Black Forest-tier loot like Coins, Amber, and Bronze-tier resources.

name: Stone forest crypt chest
description: A Stone forest crypt chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. It contains randomized loot like Coins, Amber, and Bronze-era resources.

name: Stone forest crypt chest
description: A Stone forest crypt chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. It contains randomized loot like Coins, Amber, and Bronze-era resources.

name: Chest (Plains loot)
description: A Plains treasure chest is the loot variant found inside Fuling villages and Stonehenge structures in the Plains. It contains randomized Plains-tier loot like Coins, Silver necklaces, and Onion seeds.

name: Chest (Meadows loot)
description: A Meadows treasure chest is the loot variant occasionally found in ruined buildings across the Meadows. It contains randomized early-game loot like Coins, Feathers, and Leather scraps.

name: Chest (Buried treasure loot)
description: A Buried treasure chest is a hidden loot chest that can be located in the Meadows using the Wishbone accessory. It contains valuable randomized loot, justifying the effort of digging it up.

name: Chest (Mountains loot)
description: A Mountain treasure chest is the loot variant found inside Mountain caves, ruined structures, and Drake nests. It contains randomized Mountain-tier loot like Coins, Onion seeds, and Silver necklaces.

name: Stone Plains chest
description: A Stone Plains chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Fuling villages and Stonehenge structures in the Plains. It contains randomized Plains-tier loot.

name: Stone sunken crypt chest
description: A Stone sunken crypt chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. It contains randomized loot like Ancient bark, Iron scrap, and Coins.

name: Chest (Swamp loot)
description: A Swamp treasure chest is the loot variant found inside Sunken Crypts and similar Swamp structures. It contains randomized Swamp-tier loot like Ancient bark, Iron scrap, and Coins.

name: Stone troll cave chest
description: A Stone troll cave chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Troll caves in the Black Forest. It contains randomized loot like Coins, Amber, and Bronze-era resources.

name: Troll corpse
description: Troll corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Troll is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Bonemass Vegvisir
game_description: Placeholder item for Yagluth item drop.
description: The Bonemass Vegvisir shard is an internal prefab tied to the Vegvisir runestone for Bonemass, found inside Sunken Crypts. It appears mislabeled in our data as 'Yagluth thing' — the internal ID confirms it relates to Bonemass, not Yagluth.

name: Wolf corpse
description: Wolf corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Wolf is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Ancient bark spear projectile
description: Ancient bark spear projectile is the internal projectile created when the player throws an Ancient bark spear. It deals pierce damage on impact and is not a separate carryable item.

name: Yagluth's cloud
description: Yagluth's cloud is the internal area-of-effect attack used by Yagluth when he raises his hand. It deals fire damage in a small radius and is not a player item.

name: Barrell
description: A Barrell is a wooden barrel decoration found inside ruined buildings. It can be destroyed for a small amount of Wood.

name: Bed
description: A Bed is a placeable resting station built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Deer hide. Sleeping in a bed at night skips to morning and sets the player's respawn point.

name: Bee swarm effect
description: Bee swarm effect is the internal AoE damage effect from disturbed beehives. It deals minor pierce damage to nearby targets and is not a player item.

name: Downed beech tree
description: A downed Beech tree is the trunk that remains after felling a Beech tree. It can be chopped with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Half of a downed beech tree
description: Half of a downed Beech tree is the smaller log section that remains after partially chopping a fallen Beech trunk. It can be chopped further with an axe to yield additional Wood.

name: Blast furnace
description: The Blast furnace is a Mountain-tier smelter that refines Black metal scrap into Black metal and Flametal ore into Flametal. It is built from Stone, Surtling cores, Iron, and Fine wood, and requires an Artisan table nearby to be placed.

name: Blob's area of effect attack effect
description: Blob's AoE attack effect is the internal poison cloud released when a Blob attacks or dies. It is not a player item.

name: Growth's projectile
description: Growth's projectile is the internal tar-ball attack used by Growths in the Plains. It is not a player item.

name: Boar corpse
description: Boar corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Boar is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Bonemass' area of effect attack effect
description: Bonemass's AoE attack effect is the internal poison cloud used by Bonemass in close combat. It is not a player item.

name: Bonemass projectile (spawns 4 mobs)
description: Bonemass projectile is the internal thrown-blob attack used by Bonemass that spawns four small Blobs on impact. It is not a player item.

name: Bonfire
description: The Bonfire is a large fire pit built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It provides a stronger heat source than the Campfire and grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby.

name: Fired wooden arrow
description: A fired wood arrow is the internal projectile of a Wood arrow shot from a bow. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Fired fire arrow
description: A fired Fire arrow is the internal projectile of a Fire arrow shot from a bow. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Fired frost arrow
description: A fired Frost arrow is the internal projectile of a Frost arrow shot from a bow. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Fired needle arrow
description: A fired Needle arrow is the internal projectile of a Needle arrow shot from a bow. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Fired poison arrow
description: A fired Poison arrow is the internal projectile of a Poison arrow shot from a bow. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Bronze spear projectile
description: Bronze spear projectile is the internal projectile created when the player throws a Bronze spear. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Bucket
description: A Bucket is a wooden bucket decoration found inside ruined buildings. It can be destroyed for a small amount of Wood.

name: Spice Rack
game_description: Cauldron improvement.
description: The Spice Rack is a Cauldron improvement attachment that increases the Cauldron's level, unlocking higher-tier recipes. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Bronze nails, and Carrots.

name: Butcher's table
game_description: Cauldron improvement.
description: The Butcher's table is a Cauldron improvement attachment that increases the Cauldron's level, unlocking advanced meat recipes. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Chains, and Copper.

name: Pots and pans
game_description: Cauldron improvement.
description: Pots and pans is a Cauldron improvement attachment that further increases the Cauldron's level, unlocking the highest-tier recipes. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Black metal, Fine wood, and Iron.

name: Charcoal kiln
description: The Charcoal kiln converts raw Wood into Coal over time. It is built from Stone and Surtling cores, and is unlocked once the player has obtained Surtling cores from the Black Forest's Burial Chambers.

name: Coal pile
description: A Coal pile is a placeable decorative pile of Coal lumps that emits no heat. It is purely a visual element for base decoration.

name: Cultivated soil
description: Cultivated soil is the terraforming effect produced by the Cultivator tool. Cultivated ground is required to plant crops, trees, and grass — it appears as darker, tilled soil and slowly fades back to normal grass over time.

name: Crystal wall
description: The Crystal wall 1x1 is a transparent Mountain-tier wall piece crafted from Crystal harvested from Stone Golems. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench and provides a stylish glass-like aesthetic.

name: Darkwood arch
description: The Darkwood arch is a Plains-tier decorative arch crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set introduced for darker, more refined-looking bases.

name: Darkwood beam 2m
description: The Darkwood beam 2m is a Plains-tier 2m beam crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set used for sleek, dark-themed structures.

name: Darkwood beam 4m
description: The Darkwood beam 4m is a Plains-tier 4m beam crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set used for sleek, dark-themed structures.

name: Carved Darkwood divider
description: The Carved Darkwood divider is a Plains-tier decorative wall divider crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and used as an interior partition with carved detailing.

name: Darkwood gate
description: The Darkwood gate is a Plains-tier two-piece sliding gate crafted from Fine wood, Tar, and Iron. It is part of the darkwood building set and serves as a stylish entrance for larger compounds.

name: Darkwood pole 2m
description: The Darkwood pole 2m is a Plains-tier 2m vertical pole crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and supports darkwood structures.

name: Darkwood pole 4m
description: The Darkwood pole 4m is a Plains-tier 4m vertical pole crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and supports taller darkwood structures.

name: Raven Adornment
description: The Raven Adornment is a Plains-tier decorative gable accent crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and adds a carved raven motif to roof peaks.

name: Shingle roof 26°
description: The Shingle roof 26° is a Plains-tier sloped roof piece crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and offers a sleeker alternative to thatch.

name: Shingle roof 45°
description: The Shingle roof 45° is a Plains-tier steeply-sloped roof piece crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set.

name: Shingle roof i-corner 26°
description: The Shingle roof i-corner 26° is the Plains-tier inside-corner roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Shingle roof i-corner 45°
description: The Shingle roof i-corner 45° is the Plains-tier steeply-sloped inside-corner roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Shingle roof i-corner 26°
description: The Shingle roof o-corner 26° is the Plains-tier outside-corner roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Shingle roof o-corner 45°
description: The Shingle roof o-corner 45° is the Plains-tier steeply-sloped outside-corner roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Shingle roof ridge 26°
description: The Shingle roof ridge 26° is the Plains-tier ridge-cap roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Shingle roof ridge 45°
description: The Shingle roof ridge 45° is the Plains-tier steeply-sloped ridge-cap roof variant crafted from Fine wood and Tar.

name: Wolf Adornment
description: The Wolf Adornment is a Plains-tier decorative gable accent crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It is part of the darkwood building set and adds a carved wolf motif to roof peaks.

name: Old deer corpse
description: An Old deer corpse is a decorative dead Deer object found near hunting camps or in the wild. It is purely environmental.

name: Deer corpse
description: Deer corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Deer is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Digg
description: Digg is the internal terrain-modification effect for lowering ground using the Hoe's level-and-dig modes. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Digg v2
description: Digg v2 is an updated internal terrain-modification effect for lowering ground using the Hoe. It is not a player-placed item.

name: Modor ice projectile
description: Moder's ice projectile is the internal frost-breath attack used by Moder. It is not a player item.

name: Modor's alter offering cup
description: Moder's altar offering cup is the pedestal where Dragon eggs are placed to summon Moder. It is part of Moder's Forsaken Altar structure and cannot be moved.

name: Draugr arrow
description: Draugr arrow is the internal arrow used by Draugr Archers in the Swamp. It is non-functional for the player and exists only as part of the enemy's ranged attack.

name: Draugr axe
description: Draugr axe is the internal weapon used by Draugr melee variants in the Swamp. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Draugr bow
description: Draugr bow is the internal bow used by Draugr Archers in the Swamp. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Draugr bow projectile
description: Draugr bow projectile is the internal arrow projectile used by Draugr Archers. It is non-functional for the player and exists only as part of the enemy's ranged attack.

name: Draugr sword
description: Draugr sword is the internal weapon used by Draugr Elite enemies in the Swamp. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Forest crypt door
description: A Forest crypt door is the internal door prefab for Burial Chambers in the Black Forest. Players cannot place it themselves.

name: Sunken crypt irongate
description: A Sunken crypt irongate is the internal iron-gate prefab for Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Players cannot place it themselves; the Swamp key from The Elder is required to open them.

name: Eikthyr corpse
description: Eikthyr corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when Eikthyr is defeated. It is not a player item.
The base internal eventzone prefab used for all boss-fight environment effects. It is not a player item.

name: Bonemass boss fight environment effects
description: Bonemass boss-fight environment effects are the internal eventzone that applies poison-fog visuals during the Bonemass encounter. It is not a player item.

name: Eikthyr boss fight environment effects
description: Eikthyr boss-fight environment effects are the internal eventzone that applies lightning-storm visuals during the Eikthyr encounter. It is not a player item.

name: The Elder boss fight environment effects
description: The Elder boss-fight environment effects are the internal eventzone that applies forest-fog visuals during The Elder encounter. It is not a player item.

name: Yagluth boss fight environment effects
description: Yagluth boss-fight environment effects are the internal eventzone that applies sandstorm visuals during the Yagluth encounter. It is not a player item.

name: Moder boss fight environment effects
description: Moder boss-fight environment effects are the internal eventzone that applies frost-storm visuals during the Moder encounter. It is not a player item.

name: Fermenter
description: The Fermenter is a brewing station that converts mead bases into finished meads after about two in-game days. It is built from Fine wood, Bronze, and Resin, and pairs with the Cauldron to produce the game's healing, stamina, and resistance meads.

name: Campfire
description: The Campfire is the basic Wood-burning fire built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Stone and Wood. It is required to cook food on a Cooking station and removes the Cold and Wet status effects.

name: Flint spear projectile
description: Flint spear projectile is the internal projectile created when the player throws a Flint spear. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Forge
description: The Forge is the second-tier crafting station required to craft Bronze and Iron-era weapons, armor, and tools. It is built from Stone, Wood, Coal, and Copper, and can be upgraded with attachments like the Forge cooler, Anvils, Smith's anvil, and Toolshelf to increase its level.

name: Forge bellows
game_description: Forge improvement.
description: The Forge bellows is a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood, Deer hide, and Chains.

name: Anvils
description: The Anvils are a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level. They are built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Iron.

name: Grinding wheel
description: The Grinding wheel is a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood, Sharpening stone, and Copper.

name: Smith's anvil
description: The Smith's anvil is a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level, unlocking the highest-tier weapon and tool crafts. It is built from Wood, Bronze, and Iron.

name: Forge cooler
description: The Forge cooler is a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Copper, and Freeze gland.

name: Forge toolrack
description: The Forge toolrack is a Forge improvement attachment that increases the Forge's level. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron, Wood, and Obsidian.

name: The Elder corpse
description: The Elder corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when The Elder is defeated. It is not a player item.

name: The Elder root projectile
description: The Elder root projectile is the internal root-summoning attack used by The Elder. It is not a player item.

name: Fuling banner
description: A Fuling banner is a decorative Fuling-themed banner found inside Fuling villages in the Plains. It is purely environmental and cannot be crafted.

name: Fuling bed
description: A Fuling bed is a Fuling-themed bed object found inside Fuling villages. It cannot be used by the player as a respawn point.

name: Fuling fence
description: A Fuling fence is a decorative Fuling-themed fence piece found around Fuling villages. It is purely environmental.

name: Fuling pole
description: A Fuling pole is a decorative Fuling-themed vertical pole found inside Fuling villages.

name: Fuling pole small
description: A small Fuling pole is a shorter decorative Fuling-themed pole variant.

name: Fuling roof 45°
description: A Fuling roof piece at 45° angle is a decorative thatched-roof piece used in Fuling village construction.

name: Fuling roof 45° corner
description: A Fuling roof 45° corner is a decorative thatched-roof corner piece used in Fuling village construction.

name: Fuling roof cap
description: A Fuling roof cap is the decorative ridge cap of Fuling village roofs.

name: Fuling stairs
description: Fuling stairs are decorative staircase pieces used inside Fuling villages in the Plains.

name: Fuling stepladder
description: A Fuling stepladder is a decorative ladder piece found inside Fuling villages.

name: Fuling totempole
description: A Fuling totempole is a decorative totem of Yagluth found in Fuling villages. It is purely environmental and cannot be crafted by players.

name: Fuling wood wall 1m
description: A Fuling wooden wall 1m piece is a decorative Fuling-themed wall used in Fuling village construction.

name: Fuling wood wall 2m
description: A Fuling wooden wall 2m piece is a decorative Fuling-themed wall used in Fuling village construction.

name: Fuling wood wall 2m ribs
description: A Fuling wooden wall 2m ribs is a decorative Fuling-themed ribbed-wall variant used in Fuling village construction.

name: Fulingking totemholder
description: The Fuling king totem holder is the pedestal where Fuling totems are placed to summon Yagluth. It is part of Yagluth's Forsaken Altar structure.

name: Ward
game_description: Emits a magical seal on the nearby surroundings that prevents other players from constructing buildings or opening doors.
description: The Ward (Guard stone) is a placeable claim stone crafted from Fine wood, Surtling cores, and Greydwarf eyes. When activated, it prevents other players from building, opening doors, or using chests within its radius.

name: Ward variant
description: Please note that spawning this will crash the game.

name: Drake projectile
description: Drake projectile is the internal frost-breath attack used by Drakes in the Mountains. It is not a player item.

name: Hearth
description: The Hearth is an upgraded indoor fireplace built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Stone. It functions as both Campfire and chimney, vents smoke through a Smoke vent, and is required to place the Iron cooking station.

name: Tall rock
description: A tall rock is a decorative tall stone boulder found in the Plains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Tall rock damaged
description: The damaged variant of a tall rock that has been partially mined.

name: Mistlands horizontal web
description: A Mistlands horizontal web is a hanging spider-web piece found in the Mistlands biome. It is decorative and is destructible but yields no resources.

name: Breakable floating ice sheet
description: A Breakable floating ice sheet is a Mountain biome ice formation found floating on water. It can be destroyed but yields no resources.

name: Breakable ice boulder
description: A Breakable ice boulder is a Mountain biome ice formation that can be destroyed but yields no resources.

name: Breakable ice boulder damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Breakable ice boulder that has been partially destroyed.

name: Obliterator
game_description: Burns anything to coal
description: The Obliterator is a contraption built from Iron, Copper, and Thunder stones that incinerates any items placed inside, converting them into Coins or Coal. It is a convenient way to dispose of unwanted loot late in the game.

name: Cage Floor 1x1
description: The Cage Floor 1x1 is an iron-grate floor piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron. It is most commonly used in animal pens because tames cannot pass through the grate.

name: Cage Floor 2x2
description: The Cage Floor 2x2 is a larger iron-grate floor piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron. Like the 1x1 variant, it is commonly used in animal pens.

name: Iron gate
description: An Iron gate is a destructible iron grate found blocking the entrances to Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Defeating The Elder grants the Swamp key, which unlocks these gates.

name: Cage Wall 1x1
description: The Cage Wall 1x1 is an iron-grate wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron. It is most commonly used to build see-through fences for animal pens.

name: Cage Wall 2x2
description: The Cage Wall 2x2 is a larger iron-grate wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron. Like the 1x1 variant, it is commonly used for animal pens.

name: Item stand (vertical)
description: A vertical Item stand is a placeable display piece used to hang weapons, shields, and trophies on walls. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Bronze nails.

name: Item stand (horizontal)
description: A horizontal Item stand is a placeable display piece used to lay weapons, shields, and trophies on shelves or table surfaces. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Bronze nails.

name: Obliterator lightning damage
description: Obliterator lightning damage is the internal AoE lightning effect when the Obliterator destroys items. It is not a player item.

name: Stone chest
description: A Stone chest is a stone-style loot chest variant found inside Mountain ruins and similar high-tier dungeons. It contains randomized Mountain-tier loot.

name: Chest
description: A wooden Chest is the basic player-built storage container that holds 10 stacks of items. This variant matches the loot chests found across the world and shares the same wood recipe.

name: Lox corpse
description: Lox corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Lox is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Tar pit bones
description: Tar pit bones are decorative Lox skeletal remains found near Tar pits in the Plains. They are purely environmental and cannot be picked up.

name: Lox stomp attack old
description: An old version of the Lox stomp AoE attack effect, retained for compatibility but not used in current gameplay.

name: Lox calf corpse
description: Lox calf corpse is the internal ragdoll prefab that appears when a Lox calf is killed. It is not a player item.

name: Rock stack 1
description: A rock stack is a decorative cairn-like stone marker found in the world. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Rock stack 2
description: A rock stack is a decorative cairn-like stone marker found in the world. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Muddy scrap pile (small)
description: A small Muddy scrap pile is a brown mound found inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Mining it with a pickaxe yields Iron scrap, the main Iron source in the Swamp era.

name: Muddy scrap pile (large)
description: A large Muddy scrap pile is a bigger brown mound found inside Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Mining it with a pickaxe yields multiple Iron scrap.

name: Muddy scrap pile damaged (large)
description: The damaged variant of a large Muddy scrap pile that has been partially mined.

name: Muddy scrap pile wishbone enabled
description: A Wishbone-enabled Muddy scrap pile is a hidden Muddy scrap pile detected only when the Wishbone accessory is equipped. It yields Iron scrap when mined with a pickaxe.

name: Muddy scrap pile damaged (small)
description: The damaged variant of a small Muddy scrap pile that has been partially mined.

name: Old Muddy scrap pile (small)
description: An older variant of a small Muddy scrap pile. It functions identically to the standard pile, yielding Iron scrap when mined.

name: Oozebomb explosion effect
description: Ooze bomb explosion effect is the internal AoE poison cloud released when an Ooze bomb detonates. It is not a player item.

name: Ooze bomb projectile
description: Ooze bomb projectile is the internal thrown projectile created when the player throws an Ooze bomb. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Pathen
description: Pathen is the terraforming effect produced by the Hoe's path mode. It creates a dirt path that helps reduce running stamina cost compared to grass.

name: Paved road
description: Paved road is the terraforming effect produced by the Hoe's paved-road mode, which requires Stone. It creates a stone-paved surface that provides further movement bonuses over the dirt Pathen.

name: Artisan table
description: The Artisan table is a Mountain-tier crafting station required to build the Blast furnace, Windmill, and Spinning wheel. It is built from Dragon tears, dropped by Moder, and Wood — locking late-game production behind defeating the fourth boss.

name: Black banner
description: A Black banner is a placeable decorative banner that adds a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Coal.

name: Blue banner
description: A Blue banner is a placeable decorative banner that adds a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Blueberries.

name: White & red banner
description: A White & red banner is a placeable decorative banner that adds a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Raspberries.

name: Red banner
description: A Red banner is a placeable decorative banner that adds a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Raspberries.

name: Green banner
description: A Green banner is a placeable decorative banner that adds a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Greydwarf eyes.

name: Hot tub
description: The Hot tub is a placeable Mountain-era comfort piece that produces hot steam, granting a strong Comfort bonus that extends Rested time. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Iron, and Stone.

name: Dragon bed
