description: The Dragon bed is a Mountain-tier upgraded bed crafted from Fine wood, Wolf pelts, and Iron. It functions like the standard Bed but provides additional Comfort, contributing to a longer Rested buff.

name: Beehive
description: The Beehive is a placeable apiary that produces Honey over time when set up outdoors with at least one clear cell of space around it. It is built from Wood and a Queen bee dropped from beehives in abandoned buildings in the Meadows.

name: Bench
description: A Bench is a placeable seating piece that grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Bronze nails.

name: Hanging brazier
description: A Hanging brazier is a placeable ceiling-mounted light source built with the Hammer from Iron, Wood, and Resin. It illuminates a wide area indoors and contributes to base Comfort.

name: Cartography table
description: The Cartography table is a placeable structure that allows players to share map progress and pins across a multiplayer party. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Bone fragments, Bronze nails, Leather scraps, and Raspberries.

name: Cauldron
description: The Cauldron is a cooking and brewing station required for complex recipes like soups, stews, pies, and mead bases. It is built from Tin at a Workbench and can be upgraded with attachments like the Cooking station, Spice rack, and Pots and pans.

name: Stool
description: A Stool is a basic placeable seating piece crafted from Wood. It grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby and is the simplest chair Vikings can build.

name: Chair
description: A Chair is a placeable seating piece crafted from Fine wood. It grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby and is a step up from the Stool in both appearance and Comfort value.

name: Darkwood chair
description: A Darkwood chair is a placeable Mistlands-tier seating piece crafted from Fine wood and Tar. It grants a Comfort bonus and uses the Plains-era darkwood aesthetic to fit Mistlands and Plains bases.

name: Reinforced chest
description: A Reinforced chest is a placeable storage container with more capacity than the standard Chest. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood and Iron.

name: Black metal chest
description: A Black metal chest is the largest standard storage container in the game, holding more stacks than any other chest. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Iron, and Black metal.

name: Personal chest
description: A Personal chest is a small placeable storage container that can only be opened by its placer in multiplayer. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood.

name: Treasure Chest
description: A Treasure Chest is a placeable variant of the loot chests found in dungeons. It can be built and used as decorative storage.

name: Chest
description: A Chest is the basic wooden storage container, holding 10 stacks of items. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood.

name: Cooking station
description: The Cooking station is a basic grill placed over a Campfire or Hearth used to cook Boar, Deer, and Neck meat, plus Raw fish and Mushrooms. It is built from Wood at a Workbench and is one of the first crafting stations Vikings build.

name: Iron cooking station
description: The Iron cooking station is an upgraded grill that cooks higher-tier meats like Lox, Wolf, and Serpent meat. It is built from Iron and Chains and placed over a Hearth.

name: Yuleklapp (small)
description: A small Yuleklapp is a placeable Yule-themed gift box decoration. It is available during the in-game Yule event and adds festive flair to base decoration.

name: Yuleklapp (medium)
description: A medium Yuleklapp is a placeable Yule-themed gift box decoration. It is available during the in-game Yule event and adds festive flair to base decoration.

name: Yuleklapp (large)
description: A large Yuleklapp is a placeable Yule-themed gift box decoration. It is available during the in-game Yule event and adds festive flair to base decoration.

name: Standing iron torch
description: A Standing iron torch is a placeable lightsource that uses Resin as fuel. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Iron, Wood, and Resin, and provides reliable outdoor lighting.

name: Standing blue-burning iron torch
description: A Standing blue-burning iron torch is a placeable lightsource fueled by Greydwarf eyes that emits a distinctive blue flame. It is decorative and built with the Hammer.

name: Standing green-burning iron torch
description: A Standing green-burning iron torch is a placeable lightsource fueled by Guck that emits a distinctive green flame. It is decorative and built with the Hammer.

name: Standing wood torch
description: A Standing wood torch is a placeable lightsource that uses Resin as fuel. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Resin — a simpler version of the iron variant.

name: Jack-o-turnip
description: The Jack-o-turnip is a placeable Halloween-style carved turnip jack-o-lantern. It is available during the in-game Halloween event and serves as festive decoration.

name: Sitting log
description: A Sitting log is a placeable rustic seating piece crafted from Wood. It grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby and is among the simplest seating options.

name: Maypole
description: The Maypole is a placeable Midsummer-style decorative pole. It is available during the in-game Midsummer event and serves as festive decoration.

name: Stone Oven
description: The Stone Oven is a Mistlands-tier cooking station used to bake Bread, Lox pies, and other oven-only dishes. It is built from Stone and Iron at a Workbench and must be placed near a Cauldron.

name: Sharp stakes
description: Sharp stakes are placeable defensive spikes crafted from Wood and Bronze nails. They deal pierce damage to enemies that walk into them and are most useful as base defense around walls and choke points.

name: Spinning wheel
description: The Spinning wheel is a Plains-tier crafting station that spins Flax into Linen thread. It is built from Fine wood and Iron nails and requires an Artisan table nearby to be placed.

name: Stonecutter
description: The Stonecutter is a Swamp-era crafting station required to build all Stone-based pieces such as Stone walls, Stone floors, and Stone arches. It is built from Iron, Wood, and Stone at a Workbench.

name: Table
description: A Table is a placeable wooden table built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It grants a small Comfort bonus and pairs with chairs and benches around the hearth.

name: Round table
description: A Round table is a placeable hardwood table built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood. It grants a small Comfort bonus and is a more refined version of the standard Table.

name: Raven throne
description: The Raven throne is a placeable Plains-tier comfort piece that grants a large Comfort bonus when nearby. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Black metal, and other Plains materials.

name: Stone throne
description: The Stone throne is a placeable Plains-tier comfort piece built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It grants a large Comfort bonus when nearby and pairs visually with stone-built halls.

name: Sconce
description: A Sconce is a placeable wall-mounted lightsource that uses Resin as fuel. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Resin, providing reliable indoor lighting.

name: Workbench
description: The Workbench is the fundamental crafting station required to craft most early items, build Wood structures, and repair gear. It is built from Wood and can be upgraded with attachments like the Chopping block, Tanning rack, Adze, and Tool shelf to reach higher crafting levels.

name: Chopping block
description: The Chopping block is a Workbench improvement attachment that increases the Workbench's level, unlocking higher-tier wood crafts. It is built with the Hammer from Wood and Flint.

name: Tanning rack
description: The Tanning rack is a Workbench improvement attachment that increases the Workbench's level. It is built with the Hammer from Wood, Flint, Deer hide, and Leather scraps.

name: Adze
description: The Adze is a Workbench improvement attachment that further increases the Workbench's level. It is built with the Hammer from Fine wood and Bronze.

name: Tool shelf
description: The Tool shelf is a Workbench improvement attachment that increases the Workbench's level. It is built with the Hammer from Fine wood, Iron, Obsidian, and Bronze nails.

name: Yule tree
description: The Yule tree is a placeable Christmas tree decoration available during the in-game Yule event. It serves as festive decoration and contributes a small Comfort bonus.

name: Portal made of stone
description: A Portal made of stone is the stone-style Vegvisir portal found at Forsaken Altars and other significant locations. It is purely environmental — player-built portals use the wooden Portal piece.

name: Portal
game_description: Connects another portal with equal or no tag.
description: The Portal is a Black Forest-era teleport structure built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood, Greydwarf eyes, and Surtling cores. Two Portals with matching tags connect, allowing instant travel between them.

name: Projectile beam
description: A projectile beam is an internal beam-type projectile prefab used by certain magic and special attacks. It is not a player item.

name: Abyssal harpoon projectile
game_description: The ocean's wrath.
description: An Abyssal harpoon projectile is the internal harpoon-hook projectile created when the player uses an Abyssal harpoon on a Serpent. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Projectile meteor
description: A meteor projectile is an internal falling-meteor effect used by certain Ashlands attacks. It is not a player item.

name: Fang spear projectile
description: Fang spear projectile is the internal projectile created when the player throws a Fang spear. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Raise ground
description: Raise ground is the terraforming effect produced by the Hoe's raise mode, which uses Stone to push terrain upward. It is essential for leveling building plots above water or creating defensive walls.

name: Grass
description: Grass is the terraforming effect for regrowing grass on cultivated ground using the Cultivator. It restores the natural appearance of terraformed areas.

name: Mountain boulder 1
description: A Mountain boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Mountains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Mountain boulder 1 damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Mountain boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Plain boulder 1
description: A Plains boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Plains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Plain boulder 1 damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Plains boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Mountain boulder 2
description: A Mountain boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Mountains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Mountain boulder 2 damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Mountain boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Mountain boulder 3
description: A Mountain boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Mountains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Mountain boulder 3 damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Mountain boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Silver deposite boudler
description: A Silver deposit boulder is a large rock containing Silver veins, found in the Mountains. It must be located using the Wishbone and mined with an Iron pickaxe or better to yield Silver ore.

name: Silver deposite boudler damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Silver deposit boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Coastal boulder
description: A coastal boulder is a decorative seaside rock found along Ocean shorelines. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Coastal boulder damaged
description: The damaged variant of a coastal boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Copper deposite boulder
description: A Copper deposit boulder is the large Copper-bearing rock formation found across the Black Forest. It must be mined with an Antler pickaxe or better to yield Copper ore.

name: Copper deposite boulder damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Copper deposit boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Forest boulder
description: A Forest boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Black Forest. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Forest boulder damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Forest boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Plain boulder
description: A Plains boulder is a decorative boulder found in the Plains. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Plain boulder damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Plains boulder that has been partially mined.

name: Tall rock formation
description: A Tall rock formation is a tall environmental rock prefab found in various biomes. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Small root 1
description: A Small root variant is a small decorative root prefab found in the Swamp and Mistlands. It is purely environmental.

name: Medium root 1
description: A Medium root variant is a medium-sized decorative root prefab found in the Swamp and Mistlands. It is purely environmental.

name: Small root 2
description: Another small root variant is a small decorative root prefab found in the Swamp and Mistlands. It is purely environmental.

name: Medium root 2
description: Another medium root variant is a medium decorative root prefab found in the Swamp and Mistlands. It is purely environmental.

name: Deer rug
description: The Deer rug is a placeable floor decoration crafted from Deer hide and Leather scraps. It grants a small Comfort bonus and is one of the earliest decorative rugs available.

name: Lox rug
description: The Lox rug is a placeable Plains-tier floor decoration crafted from Lox pelts. It grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby.

name: Wolf rug
description: The Wolf rug is a placeable Mountain-tier floor decoration crafted from Wolf pelts. It grants a small Comfort bonus when nearby.

name: Barley seedling
description: A Barley seedling is the young growing form of a Barley crop, planted by using a Cultivator and Barley seeds on cultivated ground. It grows into a harvestable Barley plant over time.

name: Carrot seedling
description: A Carrot seedling is the young growing form of a Carrot crop, planted by using a Cultivator and Carrot seeds on cultivated ground. It grows into a harvestable Carrot plant over time.

name: Flax seedling
description: A Flax seedling is the young growing form of a Flax crop, planted by using a Cultivator and Flax on cultivated ground. It grows into a harvestable Flax plant over time.

name: Onion seedling
description: An Onion seedling is the young growing form of an Onion crop, planted by using a Cultivator and Onion seeds on cultivated ground. It grows into a harvestable Onion plant over time.

name: Seed-carrot seedling
description: A Seed-carrot seedling is the young growing form of a Carrot that will yield seeds when fully grown. Plant a Carrot itself with the Cultivator to grow it into seed-carrots.

name: Seed-onion seedling
description: A Seed-onion seedling is the young growing form of an Onion that will yield seeds when fully grown. Plant an Onion with the Cultivator to grow it into seed-onions.

name: Seed-turnip seedling
description: A Seed-turnip seedling is the young growing form of a Turnip that will yield seeds when fully grown. Plant a Turnip with the Cultivator to grow it into seed-turnips.

name: Turnip seedling
description: A Turnip seedling is the young growing form of a Turnip crop, planted by using a Cultivator and Turnip seeds on cultivated ground. It grows into a harvestable Turnip plant over time.

name: Shaman attack area of effect
description: Shaman attack AoE is the internal damage area used by Greydwarf Shamans during their attack. It is not a player item.

name: Shaman heal area of effect
description: Shaman heal AoE is the internal heal area used by Greydwarf Shamans on nearby allies. It is not a player item.

name: Longship spawner
description: A Longship spawner is the internal placement-helper prefab used when building a Longship at a Workbench. It is not a player item.

name: Shipwreck karve bottom boards
description: Shipwreck karve bottomboards is a wreckage fragment that occasionally appears on coastlines, marking a destroyed Karve. It can be destroyed for a few Fine wood and Bronze nails.

name: Shipwreck karve bow
description: Shipwreck karve bow is the bow section of a wrecked Karve found on coastlines. It can be destroyed for Fine wood and Bronze nails.

name: Shipwreck karve chest
description: Shipwreck karve chest is a loot chest found inside a wrecked Karve on coastlines. It contains randomized Bronze-era loot.

name: Shipwreck karve dragonhead
description: Shipwreck karve dragonhead is the carved dragon-head bow piece of a wrecked Karve found on coastlines. It can be destroyed for Fine wood and Bronze nails.

name: Shipwreck karve stern
description: Shipwreck karve stern is the stern section of a wrecked Karve found on coastlines. It can be destroyed for Fine wood and Bronze nails.

name: Shipwreck karve sternpost
description: Shipwreck karve sternpost is the rear post piece of a wrecked Karve found on coastlines. It can be destroyed for Fine wood and Bronze nails.

name: Shrub 2
description: A generic decorative shrub found across multiple biomes. It is part of the world's environmental flora and yields no resources when destroyed.

name: Plains shrub 2
description: A Plains variant of the decorative shrub, with slightly different coloration to match the Plains biome. It yields no resources when destroyed.

name: Sign
description: A Sign is a placeable wooden plaque that can be written on with custom text. It is built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and is useful for labeling chests, paths, and locations.

name: Sign non usable
description: A Sign (non-usable) is an internal sign prefab without editable text. It appears in world structures and cannot be written on by the player.

name: Silver vein
description: A Silver vein is a smaller Silver-bearing rock formation found in the Mountains. It must be located using the Wishbone accessory and mined with an Iron pickaxe or better to yield Silver ore.

name: Silver vein damaged
description: The damaged variant of a Silver vein that has been partially mined.

name: Skeleton bow
description: Skeleton bow is the internal bow used by Skeleton Archer enemies in the Black Forest. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Skeleton mace
description: Skeleton mace is the internal weapon used by Skeleton melee enemies in the Black Forest. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Skeleton sword
description: Skeleton sword is the internal weapon used by Skeleton enemies in the Black Forest. It is non-functional for the player.

name: Sledge area of effect
description: Sledge AoE is the internal area-of-effect damage area created when the player swings the Stagbreaker or Iron sledge. It is not a separate carryable item.

name: Smelter
description: The Smelter refines raw ore — Copper ore, Tin ore, Iron scrap, and Silver ore — into ingots, using Coal as fuel. It is built from Stone and Surtling cores in the Black Forest era.

name: Stakewall
description: A Stakewall is a wooden palisade wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It functions both as a barrier and as a defensive piece that deals damage to enemies pushing against it.

name: Stone arch
description: The Stone arch is a Swamp-era decorative arch built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It allows arched stone openings in Stone walls without breaking line of support.

name: Stone Floor Patterned
description: Stone Floor Patterned is a decorative stone floor tile with patterned detailing, found inside pre-built world structures. It cannot be crafted but functions like a stone floor.

name: Stone floor 2x2
description: The Stone floor 2x2 is a Swamp-era stone floor tile built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It is more durable than wood and immune to rain decay.

name: Stone pile
description: A Stone pile is a placeable decorative pile of stones. It is purely a visual element for base decoration.

name: Stone pillar
description: The Stone pillar is a Swamp-era vertical stone pillar built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It is structurally strong, providing substantial support to stone construction.

name: Stone stair
description: The Stone stair is a Swamp-era staircase piece built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It provides a durable stair option that does not decay in rain like wood stairs.

name: Stone wall 1x1
description: The Stone wall 1x1 is the smallest Swamp-era stone wall piece, built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It is immune to rain decay and provides strong structural support.

name: Stone wall 2x1
description: The Stone wall 2x1 is a medium Swamp-era stone wall piece, built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It is immune to rain decay and provides strong structural support.

name: Stone wall 4x2
description: The Stone wall 4x2 is the largest Swamp-era stone wall piece, built from Stone using a Stonecutter. It is immune to rain decay and the strongest support piece for large stone halls.

name: Stone floor green
description: Stone floor green is a stone-floor fracture/decay variant used as part of the world's destructible stone construction.

name: Stone chest
description: A stonechest is a stone-style storage chest found inside specific dungeons. It functions as a loot chest containing randomized treasure.

name: Stone golem attack 1 spike
description: Stone Golem attack spike is the internal spike-volley attack used by Stone Golems. It is not a player item.

name: Stump
description: A generic stump prefab that remains after a tree is felled. It can be removed by mining it with a pickaxe to recover additional Wood.

name: Stump with spawner effect
description: A Stump with spawner effect is an internal enemy-spawner prefab disguised as a tree stump. Standing too close may trigger an enemy spawn.

name: Crypt gate
description: The Sunken crypt gate is the iron gate that bars entry to Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. The Swamp key from The Elder is required to open it.

name: Tenta root attack
description: Tentaroot attack is the internal root-emerging attack used by certain Swamp/Plains entities. It is not a player item.

name: Tolroko Flyer
description: Tolroko Flyer is an internal unused or test creature prefab. It does not appear in normal gameplay.

name: Coin pile
description: A Coin pile is a placeable decorative pile of coins that scatters when broken. It generally appears as part of dungeon loot rather than as a buildable.

name: Coin stack
description: A Coin stack is a placeable decorative stack of coins, slightly more orderly than a Coin pile. It similarly appears as part of dungeon loot rather than as a buildable.

name: Troll ground slam area of effect
description: Troll groundslam AoE is the internal damage area created when a Troll slams the ground with both hands. It is not a player item.

name: Troll horizontal log swing
description: Troll horizontal log swing is the internal melee attack used by Trolls when they swing a tree trunk horizontally. It is not a player item.

name: Troll vertical log swing
description: Troll vertical log swing is the internal melee attack used by Trolls when they swing a tree trunk vertically. It is not a player item.

name: Troll throw projectile
description: Troll throw projectile is the internal thrown-boulder attack used by Trolls at range. It is not a player item.

name: Tunnel web
description: A tunnel web is a Mistlands-themed spider-web piece used in tunnels and dungeon decoration. It is destructible but yields no resources.

name: Turf roof
description: A turf roof is a grass-covered roof piece found on pre-built buildings in the world. It cannot be crafted by the player.

name: Turf roof top
description: A turf roof top is the ridge cap variant of the turf roof. It cannot be crafted by the player.

name: Turf roof wall
description: A turf roof wall is the gable-wall variant of the turf roof. It cannot be crafted by the player.

name: Vertical web
description: A vertical web is a Mistlands-themed vertical spider-web piece used in caves and dungeons. It is destructible but yields no resources.

name: Vines
description: Vines are decorative hanging vine objects found in various biomes. They can be destroyed but yield no resources.

name: Wide stone
description: A wide stone is a decorative flat boulder found across multiple biomes. It can be mined with a pickaxe to yield Stone.

name: Wide stone damaged
description: The damaged variant of a wide stone that has been partially mined.

name: Windmill
description: The Windmill grinds Barley into Barley flour, which is required for Bread and Lox pie. It is built from Wood, Iron nails, and Stone, and requires an Artisan table nearby to be placed — restricting its construction to the Plains/Mistlands era after defeating Moder.

name: Wood beam 2m
description: The Wood beam 2m is a standard 2m horizontal wood beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is one of the most-used pieces for wood-framed structures.

name: Wood beam 1m
description: The Wood beam 1m is a short 1m horizontal wood beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is useful for small wood-framed details.

name: Wood beam 26°
description: The Wood beam 26° is an angled 26° wood beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is used as a structural support beam for sloped roofs.

name: Wood beam 45°
description: The Wood beam 45° is a steeply-angled 45° wood beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is used as a structural support beam for steeply sloped roofs.

name: Core wood stack
description: A Core wood stack is a placeable decorative stack of Core wood logs. It is purely a visual element for base decoration.

name: Wood door
description: The Wood door is the basic openable wooden door piece, built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It can be locked or unlocked from either side by the placer.

name: Wood dragon adornment
description: The Wood dragon adornment is a decorative gable accent shaped like a dragon's head, built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Fine wood. It adds Viking flair to the peak of a roof.

name: Roundpole fence
description: The Roundpole fence is a low wooden fence piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It functions as a decorative or low boundary marker and blocks small animals.

name: Fine wood stack
description: A Fine wood stack is a placeable decorative stack of Fine wood logs. It is purely a visual element for base decoration.

name: Wood floor 2x2
description: The Wood floor 2x2 is the standard wood floor tile built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is one of the most-used building pieces in Valheim.

name: Wood floor 1x1
description: The Wood floor 1x1 is a smaller wood floor tile built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is useful for filling small gaps and detail work.

name: Wood gate
description: The Wood gate is a single-piece wooden gate built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It can be opened and closed and is the basic gated entrance piece for early bases.

name: Wood ledge
description: A Wood ledge is a small decorative wood ledge piece found inside pre-built world buildings. It cannot be crafted by the player.

name: Log beam 26°
description: The Log beam 26° is an angled log beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is a sturdier alternative to the standard wood beam for log-cabin styling.

name: Log beam 45°
description: The Log beam 45° is a steeply-angled log beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is used for steep log-style supports.

name: Wood pole 1m
description: The Wood pole 1m is a short 1m vertical wood pole built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is used to support floors and other wood structures.

name: Wood pole 2m
description: The Wood pole 2m is a 2m vertical wood pole built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is one of the most-used support pieces in wood construction.

name: Log pole 2m
description: The Log pole 2m is a 2m vertical log pole built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is a sturdier alternative to the standard wood pole for log-cabin styling.

name: Log pole 4m
description: The Log pole 4m is a 4m vertical log pole built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is the tallest single log pole, useful for log-cabin walls.

name: Thatch roof 26°
description: The Thatch roof 26° is a gently-sloped thatch roof piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is the standard early-game roof piece for wood-framed houses.

name: Thatch roof 45°
description: The Thatch roof 45° is a steeply-sloped thatch roof piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood.

name: Thatch roof i-corner 26°
description: The Thatch roof i-corner 26° is the gently-sloped inside-corner thatch roof variant.

name: Thatch roof i-corner 45°
description: The Thatch roof i-corner 45° is the steeply-sloped inside-corner thatch roof variant.

name: Thatch roof o-corner 26°
description: The Thatch roof o-corner 26° is the gently-sloped outside-corner thatch roof variant.

name: Thatch roof o-corner 45°
description: The Thatch roof o-corner 45° is the steeply-sloped outside-corner thatch roof variant.

name: Thatch roof ridge 26°
description: The Thatch roof ridge 26° is the gently-sloped ridge-cap thatch roof variant.

name: Thatch roof ridge 45°
description: The Thatch roof ridge 45° is the steeply-sloped ridge-cap thatch roof variant.

name: Wood stack
description: A Wood stack is a placeable decorative stack of regular Wood logs. It is purely a visual element for base decoration.

name: Wood stair
description: The Wood stair is the basic wooden staircase piece, built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It provides three units of vertical climb per piece.

name: Wood ladder
description: The Wood ladder is a placeable wooden ladder piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It allows climbing without occupying horizontal space like a staircase.

name: Wood wall half
description: The Wood wall half is a half-height wood wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is useful for low partitions, windowsills, and detail work.

name: Log beam 2m
description: The Log beam 2m is a 2m horizontal log beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is a sturdier alternative to the standard wood beam.

name: Log beam 4m
description: The Log beam 4m is a 4m horizontal log beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood and Core wood. It is the longest standard log beam.

name: Wood wall 26°
description: The Wood wall 26° is a gently-angled wood wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is used as the angled gable wall that fits under sloped roofs.

name: Wood wall 26° (inverted)
description: The Wood wall 26° (inverted) is the inverted variant of the angled wood wall piece, used for ceiling overhangs and creative inversions.

name: Wood wall 45°
description: The Wood wall 45° is a steeply-angled wood wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It fits under steeper sloped roofs.

name: Wood wall 45° (inverted)
description: The Wood wall 45° (inverted) is the inverted variant of the steeply-angled wood wall piece, used for ceiling overhangs and creative inversions.

name: Wood roof cross 26°
description: The Wood roof cross 26° is a gently-sloped roof cross piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It bridges two roof sections at the ridge.

name: Wood roof cross 45°
description: The Wood roof cross 45° is the steeply-sloped roof cross piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood.

name: Wood Shutter
description: The Wood Shutter is a small wood-window placeholder piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It adds a window-style detail to wood walls.

name: Wood iron beam
description: The Wood iron beam is a reinforced beam built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood, Fine wood, and Iron. It provides significantly more structural support than a plain wood beam, ideal for large structures.

name: Wood iron pole
description: The Wood iron pole is a reinforced vertical pole built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood, Fine wood, and Iron. It provides significantly more structural support than a plain wood pole.

name: Wood wall
description: The Wood wall is the standard 2x2 wood wall piece built with the Hammer at a Workbench from Wood. It is one of the most-used building pieces in Valheim.

name: Wraith melee
description: Wraith melee is the internal close-combat attack used by Wraiths in the Swamp. It is not a player item.

name: Bracelets of the Brave
game_description: Your mind hardens, as do your blows.

name: Evasion Mantle
game_description: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes.

name: Heart of the Forest
game_description: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life.

name: Bronze Pendant
game_description: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear.

name: Pulsating Earrings
game_description: If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint echoes of lost souls...

name: Fins of Destiny
game_description: Empty your mind as you become shapeless and one with the water.

name: Jörmundling
game_description: Tormented screams resonate from within.

name: Brimstone
game_description: It's warm, as if filled with a lifesblood of its own.

name: Iron Brooch
game_description: A delicate yet defensive accessory.

name: Nimble Anklet
game_description: Puts a spring in your step!

name: Resounding Shackle
game_description: A razor-sharp ankle chain. Can it truly be comfortable?

name: Wolf Sight
game_description: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf.

name: Crystal Heart

game_description: Keep it warm to see what comes out.. but what came first, really?

game_description: A delicious omelette with an earthy aftertaste.

game_description: Hopefully it tastes better after cooking.

game_description: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat!

game_description: Warm to the touch, and full of protein.

game_description: Given that this bird feasts on all kinds of things, you'd better cook its meat before you even think about eating it.

name: Yggdrasil Porridge
game_description: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body.

name: Hood of Ask
game_description: As the first man of Midgard, Ask knew it was important to not draw too much attention to himself.

name: Headdress of the Bear
game_description: Let the primal rage of a mighty bear consume you.

name: Vilebone Visage
game_description: Inspiring fear in foes and courage in kin when worn.

name: Carapace Helmet
game_description: People might say you look like a giant ant. But they will only say it once.

name: Celebratory Cap
game_description: You simply can't help but feel happy when donning this cap!

name: Fishing Hat
game_description: This catchy hat may only be reeled in by the most seasoned adventurers.

name: Flametal Helmet
game_description: While you're wearing this helmet, your enemies will think twice before trying to bite your head off.

game_description: A fancy green headscarf.

game_description: A fancy red headscarf.

game_description: A warm fur cap, made from the finest wool.

game_description: A warm cap for special occasions.

name: Eitr-weave Hood
game_description: Sorcery shows itself in the eyes, so most mages wear cowls to disguise their occult pursuits.

name: Hood of Embla
game_description: Even the first sorceress valued the mystique of covering one's face. It is rumoured that honouring her this way will make your spells even more powerful.

name: Midsummer Crown
game_description: Celebrate summer with a crown woven from flowers.

name: Pointy Hat
game_description: This hat is sure to add a bit of magical flair to any outfit.

game_description: The perfect way to avoid sunstroke.

game_description: It feels a bit...moist.

game_description: An acidic smell still lingers. Prominently.

game_description: This sturdy leather is thick, and still warm to the touch.

game_description: A neck in its final stage of life.

game_description: These ribs have already been stripped clean of any meat.

game_description: A thick skull, with room for a surprisingly large brain.

name: Curious Axe Head
game_description: The metal glints oddly in the sunlight. Somehow, you know that it can never be complete on its own...

name: Mysterious Axe Head
game_description: What battles has this weapon borne witness to? You cannot see its past, only shape its future...

name: Barber Kit
game_description: A kit fit for the finest of barbers.

game_description: These metal rings are perfectly round, suitable for holding a barrel together. Just add wood!

name: Bear Hide
game_description: A thick and furry hide, coarse yet incredibly soft.

name: Bear Paw
game_description: Sharp claws suitable for picking berries – or for dismembering.

name: Ashwood
game_description: Wood hardened by fire and ash.

name: Bonemaw Scale
game_description: It looks just like bone. Best not to question the anatomy of this creature too much...

name: Bonemaw Tooth
game_description: This has caused the death of many a brave sailor.

name: Scrap Bronze
game_description: It's old and oxidized but can be smelted and used again.

name: Candle Wick
game_description: Steep these in something flammable for a long lasting and cosy light source.

name: Celestial Feather
game_description: The only remnant of the fallen valkyrie's former self.

name: Ceramic Plate
game_description: No matter how hot this gets, the other side of it remains strangely cool.

name: Charcoal Resin
game_description: The resin from a tree that was set ablaze a long time ago. It's still ready to burn some more.

name: Charred Bone
game_description: Followed by the distinct smell of burnt meat.

name: Charred Cogwheel
game_description: This could be used for some clever machinery...

name: Charred Skull
game_description: The blackened skull of a long-dead warrior. It's unlikely that a proper burial would grant them any peace.

name: Copper Scrap
game_description: One person's scrap is another person's treasure.

name: Cured Squirrel Hamstring
game_description: Elastic and strong. This tendon must have come from a quick and agile animal.

name: Dvergr Extractor
game_description: Looks like a perfect piece for piercing something...

name: Ectoplasm
game_description: A restless essence of a once living thing...

name: Ashlands Gourmet Bowl
game_description: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

name: Black Forest Buffet Platter
game_description: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

name: Whole Roasted Meadow Boar
game_description: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

name: Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands
game_description: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

name: Hearty Mountain Logger's Stew
game_description: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

name: Sailor's Bounty
game_description: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

name: Plains Pie Picnic
game_description: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

name: Swamp Dweller's Delight
game_description: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

name: Blue Fireworks
game_description: This rocket's blasting off again!

name: Hot Fishing Bait
game_description: Some fish already like it where the waters are warm, and this bait brings the temperature close to boiling.

name: Cold Fishing Bait
game_description: This bait doesn't look like much, but it's a treat to fish that live where it's cold and dark.

name: Frosty Fishing Bait
game_description: It's not very nutritious, so the only fish that'll take this bait are the ones that are used to just eating ice.

name: Mossy Fishing Bait
game_description: Dead trolls in the forest often attract a fish or two, speed up the process with this bait!

name: Misty Fishing Bait
game_description: A bait to guide the fish to you through shrouded waters.

name: Heavy Fishing Bait
game_description: This bait sinks deep, deep enough to lure the fish swimming along the very bottom of the sea.

name: Stingy Fishing Bait
game_description: You're not immune to deathsquito bites, and the fish here aren't immune to this snack!

name: Sticky Fishing Bait
game_description: It might smell foul, but the fish drawn to this bait are used to so much worse.

name: Flametal
game_description: According to legend, this metal was used by the gods themselves to craft powerful weapons.

name: Flametal Ore
game_description: Warm to the touch with glowing veins of strange metal. Needs to be refined in a blast furnace.

name: Fragrant Bundle
game_description: These plants carry a strong but pleasant scent. However, it's possible that not all creatures agree...

name: Fresh Seaweed
game_description: The saltwater scent of this plant makes you think of the wide open ocean.

name: Iolite
game_description: Light is reflected sharply off of this gem, or does it come from within the stone itself?

name: Jade
game_description: This gem pulses with energy, almost as if it were a living thing.

name: Bloodstone
game_description: You wonder how many deals have been made to appease this gem. How many palms have bled onto it in exchange for its power?

name: Grausten
game_description: Porous yet sturdy.

name: Uncooked Honey Glazed Chicken
game_description: Ready for the oven.

name: Iron Pit
game_description: An empty vessel waiting to be filled with firewood and kindling.

name: Blue Jute
game_description: Made from natural fibers and dvergr hair.

name: Red Jute
game_description: A sturdy, rough fabric.

name: Uncooked Meat Platter
game_description: Ready for the oven.

game_description: A mysterious contraption built by the Dvergr. Used to build traps.

game_description: Ready for the oven.

name: Morgen Heart
game_description: It's hard to believe it has ever beaten.

name: Morgen Sinew
game_description: Chewy.

name: Pot Shard
game_description: A fragment of something brittle.

name: Powdered Dragon Eggshells
game_description: Dragon egg is a hard and difficult material to work with, yet here it has been ground to a fine, glittering dust...

name: Proustite Powder
game_description: This unstable powder packs great potential.

name: Pungent Pebbles
game_description: An earthy odour clings to these dried lumps. It's best to not think too hard about what they are.

name: Scythe Handle
game_description: A sturdy base for a tool.

name: Fiery Spice Powder
game_description: Whatever spices have been used in this blend, they must come from someplace hot. And as if that wasn't enough, they have also been dried and smoked before being ground into a fine powder.

name: Woodland Herb Blend
game_description: Thyme and marjoram carefully harvested and dried, before being mixed together. This blend will turn even the most basic of ingredients into a delicious feast.

name: Herbs of the Hidden Hills
game_description: A good herbalist knows exactly where to go to find ramsons, but she won't tell you the secrets of her trade! Still, if you have the coin for it you may treat yourself to this blend of finely harvested ramson bulbs and leaves.

name: Mountain Peak Pepper Powder
game_description: Only the most seasoned herbalist can find the pepperwood tree and harvest its leaves and bark. After careful preparation it's ready to be added to food, and is sure to give it some warming heat.

name: Seafarer's Herbs
game_description: The sour tang of sorrel, mixed with something the herbalist would rather not disclose, is well suitable for fish. Any fisherfolk worth their salt would do well to keep this blend near, in case of a good catch!

name: Grasslands Herbalist Harvest
game_description: This blend utilises all aspects of the lovage plant, a rarity in the tenth world. Roots, leaves and seeds have all been gathered, and then mixed together in the perfect quantity.

name: Rock
game_description: It's a stone.

name: Sulfur
game_description: Smells like rotten eggs.

name: Vile Ribcage
game_description: A relic of savage strength, perfect for forging armour that bears the wild’s fury.

name: Fenris Claw
game_description: It is hard and sharp like iron.

name: Fenris Hair
game_description: A bundle of thick, rough hair. It has a strong smell.

name: Bell
game_description: For whom does the bell toll?

name: Bell Fragment
game_description: This ancient fragment appears to be a piece of a broken bell...

name: Corked Vial
game_description: Thick enough to contain something volatile, yet fragile enough to be shattered.

name: Sealbreaker
game_description: An object used to break a Dverger seal.

name: Dyrnwyn Blade Fragment
game_description: Parts of an old blade. If all the pieces were reassembled it could likely be made whole.

name: Dyrnwyn Hilt Fragment
game_description: The hilt of a long forgotten sword. Perhaps it could be reforged if one had all the pieces...

name: Dyrnwyn Tip Fragment
game_description: This shard of metal looks like the tip of a sword. One might be able to reforge the blade if more pieces are found...

name: Kindled Ribs
game_description: The smouldering remains of a patriarch.

name: Hildir's Brass Key
game_description: It seems to be missing its owner...

game_description: It seems to be missing its owner...

name: Hildir's Bronze Key
game_description: It seems to be missing its owner...

name: Majestic Carapace
game_description: Her majesty's will was hard and unrelenting, but this piece of carapace is perhaps even more so.

name: Horn of Celebration
game_description: One year since we arrived... Skål!

name: Dvergr Tankard
game_description: It can hold a lot of mead!

name: Carapace Shield
game_description: The almost unbreakable carapace of your enemies makes an excellent shield.

name: Carapace Buckler

name: Flametal Shield
game_description: The shield is and always will be a viking's most important weapon.

name: Flametal Tower Shield
game_description: The best defence is a great defence.

name: Serving Tray
game_description:
Set the table with whatever food and drink you fancy, and impress your guests with a delicious feast.

name: Scythe

game_description: Don't let yourself be fooled by the friendly smile, for it could easily bite your arm off.

game_description: That stare is still frightening...

game_description: These eyes are finally vacant for good.

name: Bonemaw Trophy

name: Marksman Trophy
game_description: These legs could hold infinite power.

name: Warlock Trophy
game_description: A warm glow seems to almost emanate from within. Handle with care.

name: Warrior Trophy
game_description: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years.

name: Cultist Trophy
game_description: My, what big teeth it has...

name: Geirrhafa Trophy
game_description: He's giving you an icy stare.

name: Draugr Trophy
game_description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...

game_description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...

name: Dvergr Trophy
game_description: It's frankly a little troubling that you would consider hanging these on your wall...

name: Fader Trophy
game_description:
The green dragon, corrupted beyond redemption.

Offer him to the sacrificial stones.

name: Fallen Valkyrie Trophy
game_description: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow.

name: Troll Trophy
game_description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

name: Troll Trophy
game_description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

name: Ghost Trophy
game_description: Does it still whisper about unfinished business?

name: Gjall Trophy
game_description: Hopefully it won't float away.

name: Thungr Trophy
game_description: Not so tough now.

name: Zil Trophy
game_description: In the choice of 'ride or die', he picked the latter.

name: Hare Trophy
game_description: These are said to bring luck. But not for their original owner.

name: Morgen Trophy
game_description: The waking nightmare has met its end.

name: Seeker Trophy
game_description: Less delicate than they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight.

name: Seeker Soldier Trophy

game_description:
She has seen enough.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
